_note: The second grading pass. Every frame Phase 1 never looked at, graded against `content/photo-selects.json`'s criteria VERBATIM by two independent graders, with a third adjudicating disagreements. `subject` is what a grader saw in the frame and is the source of alt text — nothing here is generated from a filename. Regenerate the sheet with `npm run grading:sheet`, then merge with `npm run grading:merge`.

method.standard: content/photo-selects.json criteria, verbatim, plus that curator's worked examples
method.adjudicator: a third grader, on disagreements only
method.flagRule: Flags are a UNION across graders. A flag is a claim that a frame may not be this property, and the cost of publishing somebody else's hotel is far higher than the cost of dropping one frame from a library of 640.

frames.subject: Family stepping out through a wooden villa gate onto a paved path
frames.reason: Real, warm arrival moment with stone wall, oleander and a clean white entrance, but it is people-led and shot in hard overhead light with a blown white sky at the top. Usable support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Family walking down a dirt track to a rocky shore, sea beyond
frames.reason: A graffiti-covered concrete block sits at the right edge and strangers with umbrellas are scattered along the shoreline; flat, harsh midday light and a featureless pale sky. Clutter defect.
frames.flagReason: Rocky public-looking shoreline with graffiti and other bathers; reads as open coast rather than the estate's private beach.

frames.subject: Family standing on a sandy rise above a rocky shore with bathers in the water
frames.reason: The top half of the vertical frame is empty hazed-out sky, the group is small and turned away, and strangers with beach umbrellas clutter the middle ground. Snapshot framing, flat light.
frames.flagReason: Other bathers and umbrellas on a rocky open shore; cannot tell this is the private beach rather than adjacent public coast.

frames.subject: Parents holding hands at the water's edge while two children paddle in the surf
frames.reason: Warm, believable holiday moment with a good sweep of shoreline and breaking surf, but the sky is blown to blank white and the light is hazy rather than shaped. Good support frame.

frames.subject: Father and two children standing in the sea, backs to camera, open water beyond
frames.reason: Simple composition and lovely teal water carry it, but the sky is flat and colourless and the figures sit small in the lower right. Real and usable; not hero light.

frames.subject: Family sitting on the sand at the shoreline watching the breaking surf
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: a wide band of out-of-focus sand runs across the bottom third, all four bodies are sliced off by the bottom edge, everyone is backs-to-camera and the child at right is buried behind the man's shoulder. Hard overhead light has bleached the sky to near-white and there is no property context. Grader Two is right that the surf and horizon are handsome, but that is the only thing carrying the frame.

frames.subject: Couple with drinks on a curtained daybed beside a pool, oleander behind
frames.reason: Clean blue sky, flowering shrubs and the turquoise pool edge make it appealing, but it is a posed to-camera portrait in hard light with a lounger cropped awkwardly at the left edge. Support, not hero.

frames.subject: Girl leaping by a poolside daybed as her family sits watching, pool in the foreground
frames.reason: Bright, happy and unmistakably poolside, with good water colour, but the composition is bottom-heavy with plain pool water and a blank white panel behind the cabana; harsh midday light. Usable support.

frames.subject: Children swimming in a private pool while adults sit on a curtained daybed
frames.reason: Warm late light on the stone wall and timber deck, genuine and inviting, but busy at the right edge with cropped sun loungers and a wall light box breaking the stonework. Good support frame.

frames.subject: Family at a breakfast table under a shade canopy, a staff member serving
frames.reason: Real and warm with soft light, garden hedges and a sliver of sea, but the canopy eats the top third of the frame, the sky is blown, and the table is busy. Classic B: usable, people-led, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Orange juice being poured at an outdoor breakfast table set with cold cuts and blue glassware
frames.reason: The diner is decapitated by the top edge — cut just below the eyes — and the largest, sharpest object in the frame is a platter of sliced ham and salami across the bottom. A branded jam jar sits centre frame and goblets are clipped on both sides. The golden backlight and blue glass are genuinely attractive, but the composition and the processed-meat subject put it outside the register.

frames.subject: Boy at a breakfast table while juice is poured into a blue goblet
frames.reason: A headless adult torso fills the top right, the tabletop is cluttered with eggs, jars and glasses, and a white plastic chair intrudes at the left. Snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Cheese platter with dried fruit, nuts and boiled eggs on a sunlit breakfast table
frames.reason: The best composed of the breakfast frames: the white tray is the clear centred subject, the styling is on-register local produce with rosemary and apricots, and the raking side light gives it real texture. Held back to support by the cropped hand at top right, the two big out-of-focus goblets clipped into the bottom corners, and hard midday shadows on the cloth.

frames.subject: Pancakes with chocolate spread and jam beside a platter of sliced cold cuts
frames.reason: A large plate of processed ham and salami occupies the top half, a cropped hand and spoon enter from the left edge, and the whole thing sits on a perforated white metal cafe table whose dot pattern fights everything on it. Hard direct sun, no styling depth. Appetising in parts, but it reads as canteen breakfast, not luxury villa.

frames.subject: Family eating fruit at a green picnic table on a lawn, oleander and white buildings behind
frames.reason: Soft evening light on the group and a genuinely pretty garden setting, but the sky is blown out to white and a thin pole rises behind the shrubs. Good support.

frames.subject: High-angle view of a family at a green picnic table with fruit and empty plates
frames.reason: Awkward crop: the woman at the right edge is cut in half and the boy is cut at the left; empty white plates dominate the tabletop and the angle reads as an offhand snapshot. Weaker duplicate of the same set-up.

frames.subject: Family sharing fruit at a green picnic table, garden path and hedges behind
frames.reason: Best-lit frame of this table series, warm and natural with depth into the garden, but the girl in the foreground is cropped at the bottom edge and the table's empty plates flatten the front. Support, not hero.

frames.subject: Family dining at a wooden table beside an outdoor kitchen counter
frames.reason: Overhead power cables cross the sky at top left, a security camera is mounted on the white wall, a large furled grey umbrella cuts through the centre, and the sky is blown white.

frames.subject: Family at a wooden dining table beside a white villa wall, hot tub on the deck behind
frames.reason: A power cable runs across the sky, a black furled umbrella dominates the right edge, and empty black chair backs cut across the whole foreground. Cluttered snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Greek salad with feta, bread basket and red wine on a wooden table
frames.reason: Warm low light, good colour and a convincing taverna-at-home feel, but the frame is busy with part-cropped plates and hands at the edges. Strong support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Family at a wooden dinner table in front of an outdoor sink counter
frames.reason: The man's out-of-focus head fills the left foreground, a cable crosses the blown white sky, and a security camera and sink unit sit centre-frame behind the boy. Utility clutter.

frames.subject: Plates of dolmades, sliced meat and rice with red wine on a wooden table
frames.reason: Appetising, warmly lit and cleanly arranged on the timber slats, though the top of the frame is cut through with half-plates and glasses. Good food support.

frames.subject: Couple seated at a small table at the water's edge with the sea filling the frame
frames.reason: The file is tiny and visibly soft — unusable above thumbnail size. Both subjects are backs-to-camera, the folding chair frames dominate the lower half and are cut by the bottom edge, the table is clipped at right, and the light has no character. Nice idea, no execution and no property context.
frames.flagReason: Low-resolution frame with no property signature at all; reads like a generic seaside-dining image and cannot be confirmed as this estate.

frames.subject: Toy red car resting on a printed car rental agreement form
frames.reason: A generic commercial concept illustration, not a photograph of anything at the property. Nothing of the estate in frame.
frames.flagReason: Classic stock illustration for car hire; a toy car on a form has no connection to the property.

frames.subject: Roped-off turtle nest with reed fencing and an information sign on grey sand
frames.reason: Flat dull light, phone-snapshot framing, and the frame is filled with stakes, tape, a printed sign and a blue folding chair at the corner. Utility clutter throughout.
frames.flagReason: Managed nest enclosure with a public information sign and a folding chair; cannot tell whether this is the estate's own beach.

frames.subject: Turtle hatchling crossing rippled sand in low sun
frames.reason: Soft, off-vertical phone snapshot with the subject small and centred in an empty field of sand; no property context and no craft in the framing.
frames.flagReason: Wildlife close-up with nothing identifiable in frame; cannot confirm it was shot on this property.

frames.subject: Close-up of a turtle hatchling on coarse pebbly sand
frames.reason: Phone-grade close-up, harsh mixed light with a burnt-out patch top right, and no compositional idea beyond pointing at the animal.
frames.flagReason: Isolated wildlife close-up with no property context; cannot confirm it was shot here.

frames.subject: Gold circular award badge reading Conde Nast Traveler 2024
frames.reason: Not a photograph at all, it is a third-party accolade graphic. Nothing of the property, and it cannot carry any image slot.
frames.flagReason: Carries another company's logo and branding rather than property imagery.

frames.subject: Blue line-drawn circular logo above the words Crete Holiday Home
frames.reason: A vector logo on black, not a photograph. No property, no light, no composition to grade.
frames.flagReason: Another company's logo and wordmark rather than imagery of this estate.

frames.subject: Family holding hands at the shoreline facing a low sun over the sea
frames.reason: Golden hour at its best: the sun disc sits on a clean horizon, warm light rakes across wet sand and breaking surf, and the curving shoreline leads straight to the group. Simple, cinematic and expensive-looking. Full-bleed capable.

frames.subject: Two children playing in a hot tub with a leafy tree and lawn behind
frames.reason: Genuine, happy interaction and pretty soft green background, but the tub's control pads and floating toys clutter the water, plastic loungers sit in the background, and the sky is a flat white patch. Support only.

frames.subject: Children in a hot tub seen past out-of-focus adults and bottles at a table
frames.reason: Power cables cross the sky top left, blurred foreground bodies and drink bottles block the bottom third, and the hot tub's cabinet, stickers and control panel dominate the middle. Cluttered snapshot.

frames.subject: Family beside a turquoise pool, children swimming
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: the woman in the foreground is out of focus and cropped by the frame edge, a white pool-cleaner unit sits in the water, and a red-and-white NO DIVING signboard plus a galvanised pole break the far fence line.

frames.subject: Outdoor table laid with blue glassware, sea beyond hedges
frames.reason: Warm light, shallow depth and clean linen make it real and usable, but the sky is blown to flat white, the sea horizon is barely readable, and a branded jam jar sits centre-table. Good support, not a hero.

frames.subject: Family eating at an outdoor kitchen table beside a pool
frames.reason: A white pool-cleaner box sits dead centre in the foreground water, an overhead cable crosses the top-left sky, and a furled black umbrella cuts vertically through the diners. Cluttered documentary framing.

frames.subject: Turquoise water in a rocky gorge
frames.reason: A small, soft, low-resolution crop of a shaded river gorge with harsh contrast and no composition to speak of. Nothing of the estate is in frame.
frames.flagReason: Natural gorge/river landscape, a public inland beauty spot rather than the villa grounds or the private beach.

frames.subject: Chef seasoning canapés on a wooden board
frames.reason: Small, soft, dimly lit interior frame; the cook's face is cut by his own arm and the background is dark cabinetry and louvred blinds. Reads as generic culinary documentation.
frames.flagReason: A dark professional-looking prep kitchen with no property context at all — could be an off-site cooking-class or restaurant venue rather than a villa space.

frames.subject: Sunset over a Venetian harbour lined with waterfront houses
frames.reason: Genuinely handsome light and reflections, but it is a town harbour view, heavily processed, and small in resolution. Usable as area content only, never as property imagery.
frames.flagReason: This is a public Venetian-era town harbour with moored fishing boats and quayside tavernas, not Thalasses.

frames.subject: Aerial of a seafront terrace, pool and helipad above the beach
frames.reason: Harsh overhead midday light, and most of the frame is dry brown scrub, ploughed dirt and parked cars. The painted helipad and service yard dominate; the pool and beach umbrellas are incidental. Documentary survey shot.

frames.subject: Aerial of white villas above a blue sea
frames.reason: Strong deep blue sea and clear sky, and it explains the setting well, but hard midday light, and the right third is bare farmland and ploughed rows. Orienting support, not a hero.

frames.subject: Poolside terrace with palms at sunset, guests gathered
frames.reason: Phone-snapshot framing: a man is cropped at the left edge with his back to camera, empty glasses and a bottle are left on the deck in the bottom corner, and the horizon sits dead centre under a washed-out sky.

frames.subject: Couple at a low table on the shore at sunset
frames.reason: Hero-grade: the sun sits low on a clean sea horizon with mountains across the bay, lanterns anchor the table, and the composition is simple and cinematic. Sells the private-shoreline dinner story in one frame.

frames.subject: Lit pool at dusk under a string of bulbs, palms and sea beyond
frames.reason: Controlled blue-hour light: the string of bulbs draws a clean arc across a graded sky, palms are mirrored in still blue-lit water, and the sea closes the horizon. Expensive-looking and full-bleed capable.

frames.subject: Elevated view of a pool-terrace reception at dusk
frames.reason: Real and usable for events, but it is documentation — dozens of guests, draped cocktail tables, a thatched bar and vans parked at the right edge, all under a flat blown-out sky.

frames.subject: Guests around a blue pool by the sea in late light
frames.reason: Snapshot composition with a light stand and camera gear mid-frame, guests scattered facing away, and dark unlit foreground concrete. The pool edge cuts awkwardly through the bottom corner.

frames.subject: Young man in a white shirt at a terrace wall at golden hour
frames.reason: A guest portrait with no property in frame beyond bare palm trunks and a white wall; a second person and a microphone stand intrude at the right edge. Nothing here says villa estate.

frames.subject: Guests dancing on a poolside terrace under festoon lights at dusk
frames.reason: Warm low dusk light, festoon strings, palms and the pool all read, and it is honest, lively event coverage of exactly the kind Phase 1 kept as support. Not hero: the bottom third is bare grey concrete, the sky is blown to flat cream, a draped cocktail table is cut hard at the left edge and a wooden shed sits in the background.

frames.subject: Buffet chafing dishes on white-clothed tables
frames.reason: Stainless chafing trays and serving spoons fill the frame, with a PA speaker on a stand and utility poles with cables in the background. Catering equipment, explicitly excluded.

frames.subject: Palm reflected in a blue-lit pool at dusk
frames.reason: Lovely dusk gradient and a clean palm reflection in the water, but a black backpack and bags are left on the deck, towels hang over the loungers, and the magenta deck wash reads clubby rather than expensive.

frames.subject: Round tables set for dinner beside a pool
frames.reason: Sky is blown to featureless white, a baby stroller sits in the left foreground, and guests wander through mid-frame. Snapshot event coverage rather than a composed set-table frame.

frames.subject: Bartender pouring a measure at a wooden bar
frames.reason: The subject is decapitated by the top edge, the frame is filled by a plain black t-shirt, and the surface is littered with branded bottles and syrup pumps. No property context.
frames.flagReason: Third-party branded liquor bottles are prominent in the frame and there is no property context — the same concern the standard raises about branded beverage imagery.

frames.subject: Palms mirrored in a still pool at dusk
frames.reason: The mirror-still water and symmetrical palm reflections are genuinely good, but the sky is a flat blown white, and a photographer with a tripod, a black equipment case and towel-strewn loungers clutter both edges.

frames.subject: Person silhouetted in a white frame above a lit pool at dusk
frames.reason: Strong symmetry and a warm-to-blue dusk gradient, but the posing guest with arms thrown up is a holiday snapshot gesture, the file is soft, and bags are visible on the far wall. Near-duplicate of the cleaner pool frames.

frames.subject: Guests at a low shoreline table watching the sunset
frames.reason: Real warmth and a good sun path on the water, but it is people-led with a row of backs of heads across the frame, and the foreground is a dull band of dark gravel.

frames.subject: Outdoor dinner under string lights at blue hour
frames.reason: Genuine blue-hour atmosphere and a nice sweep of bulbs, held back by a utility pole and overhead wires in the background, a white pop-up canopy at the left and a parked van behind the wall.

frames.subject: Candles in glass holders on white steps at dusk
frames.reason: Quiet and well-observed — three flames stepping diagonally down whitewashed concrete in soft dusk light. It is a detail frame, not full-bleed material, and a stray cloth hangs on the reed fence behind.

frames.subject: Whitewashed entrance gateway with the property sign
frames.reason: The sky is blown to flat white and the bottom third is empty grey asphalt with tyre marks; a camper van and construction-looking white forms sit behind the left palm. Record shot, not editorial.

frames.subject: Open wooden gate onto a pool terrace
frames.reason: Broken concrete and rough stone steps fill the foreground, laundry or a towel hangs over the wall at the right, and a lone guest sits mid-frame under a washed-out white sky. Snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Chalkboard drinks sign beside an ice bucket
frames.reason: A self-service catering sign, a sweating steel bucket and plastic ivy at very tight range — service signage and catering gear, with nothing of the property visible.

frames.subject: Bartender uncorking a wine bottle
frames.reason: Head cropped off by the frame, a plain black torso occupying most of the picture, and grey rubbish bins parked in the left background. Utility clutter and snapshot cropping.

frames.subject: Palms and string lights reflected in still blue water
frames.reason: An elegant graphic abstract — palm crowns and a line of bulbs mirrored on flat blue. Handsome as a texture or section break, but it carries no place or architecture, so it cannot lead as a hero.

frames.subject: Dressed dinner tables on a terrace in low sun
frames.reason: Warm backlight rims the chairs and glassware and the tables are properly dressed, but the sky is blown white, the lower half is bare concrete, and guests in swimwear stand in the background.

frames.subject: Cocktail chalkboard and an ice bucket of bottles on a bar
frames.reason: Handwritten service board and a bucket of branded beer bottles, with a PA speaker on a stand, plastic bottles and clutter filling the background. Catering gear and signage.
frames.flagReason: Third-party beer branding is the visual centre of the shot — the same objection the standard records against the branded beer-bucket frames.

frames.subject: Wedding guests dancing on a seafront pool deck at dusk beneath palms
frames.reason: Same evening and same register as the tighter dancing frame and no stronger — usable events support, not full bleed. The wider lens pushes the dancers small and leaves an even larger empty slab of concrete across the lower half, with a construction joint running through it, and the sky is blown flat. Kept at B because the dusk light on the palms and the pool is genuinely warm.

frames.subject: Guests seated in black plastic chairs on a rocky shore watching the sun set over the sea
frames.reason: Sunset light on the water is good, but the foreground is a wall of black plastic monobloc chairs and backs of heads, with a marquee edge and a dressed trestle table at left; event documentation and cheap furniture, exactly the reject register.

frames.subject: Blue-lit pool at dusk mirroring palm trees, with a white wedding arch and sea beyond
frames.reason: Genuinely handsome blue-hour colour and a clean palm reflection, but a figure caught mid-gesture with an arm raised reads as a candid snapshot, and the left edge carries red and blue clutter while a dressed table crowds the right. Usable support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Miniature branded ouzo bottles piled in a woven basket, shot close
frames.reason: Tight third-party product close-up with no property context at all — indistinguishable from commercial beverage stock, and the labels put another company's brand centre frame rather than anything of the estate.
frames.flagReason: Carries another company's branding (ouzo labels) and no visible property context; cannot confirm it is this estate's own imagery.

frames.subject: Stainless chafing dishes of grilled meat and rice on white-clothed buffet tables
frames.reason: Catering equipment front and centre — the curator's named reject — compounded by a utility pole and overhead cables across the background skyline and a staff member walking through frame.

frames.subject: Two women dancing barefoot on a concrete terrace in front of a thatched bar
frames.reason: Party snapshot: a PA speaker on a black tripod stand with trailing cable at left, a utility pole and wires against the sky, a white pop-up canopy and a guest walking out of frame. Flat late light and no composition.

frames.subject: Two open-sided canopies over low cushioned tables on a rocky beach at sunset
frames.reason: Warm low sun, clean horizon and a symmetric pair of shelters carry the private-beach story, but the canopies are plain grey rental pop-ups on scruffy, debris-strewn ground and the sun is hidden behind fabric. Real and usable, not a hero.

frames.subject: Pool lit blue at twilight with magenta deck lighting, loungers and palm reflections
frames.reason: Attractive blue-hour reflection and colour, but towels and coloured bags are draped over the wall and strewn on the loungers, and the magenta uplighting reads more nightclub than luxury. Good support frame.

frames.subject: Sun setting behind a distant headland over a calm sea, seen from a dark shoreline
frames.reason: Hazy, low-contrast sky and a dead, featureless band of shadowed ground across the bottom; centred-sun snapshot framing with nothing of the property in it.

frames.subject: Low sun over the sea with a rocky shoreline and sun path in the foreground
frames.reason: Good golden light, a clean sun path and real texture in the rocks, but a foreground boulder carries a blue spray-paint tag and the frame is a generic coastal sunset with no property signature. Usable support.

frames.subject: Guests seated on cushions under beach canopies as the sun sets over the sea
frames.reason: Warm sunset, guests relaxed and the coastline reading well behind, but the shelters are utilitarian pop-up frames and the lower half is flat scruffy sand. Real and warm, not strong enough for full bleed.

frames.subject: Large pool at dusk under strung festoon lights with guests gathered beyond
frames.reason: The festoon arc and dusk sky give real evening atmosphere, but over half the frame is featureless blue water and the far side is a jumble of marquees, umbrellas, distant buildings and a small crowd. Event documentation.

frames.subject: Dressed banquet tables and folding chairs around a seafront pool at golden hour
frames.reason: The most useful establishing frame of the event terrace: pool, palms, sea horizon and laid tables all present, with warm low light. Not hero — the sky is blown to flat white, a speaker stand, a pram and scattered chairs clutter the right side, and the bottom edge is a strip of scarred concrete and a floor mat.

frames.subject: Hands pouring iced tea from a glass dispenser into a cut-glass tumbler
frames.reason: Cropped catering detail: a black rubber bar mat fills the lower third and plastic ivy garland runs through the frame. Bar service documentation, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Pool at dusk reflecting palm trees, with a white arch and guests at the sea wall
frames.reason: Calm symmetry and a clean palm reflection, but the sky is pale and empty, towels and bags clutter the loungers at left, and a photographer with a light stand stands at the right edge. Good support, not hero.

frames.subject: Dressed dinner table with coloured glassware set beside a pool
frames.reason: Two plastic water bottles stand upright in the centre of the table, killing an otherwise smart setting; behind them guests sit with feet in the pool in swimwear and the background is blown out white.

frames.subject: Pool glowing blue at twilight beneath festoon lights and silhouetted palms
frames.reason: Lovely twilight gradient and palm silhouettes, but the frame is visibly soft and noisy, a blurred figure moves at the right edge and a wide empty expanse of grey deck occupies the right third. Atmospheric support.

frames.subject: Beach canopies with guests on cushions, palms and a terrace on the rise behind
frames.reason: A graffiti tag is sprayed across the white retaining wall at left, the sky is a large empty pale expanse and the foreground is bare stony dirt. Golden light cannot carry the clutter.

frames.subject: Aerial of a poolside party on a seafront terrace at dusk
frames.reason: Reads clearly as the estate and gives a useful sense of the grounds and the sea, but it is busy with people and event kit, the light is flat and hazy, and parked white vans and a car sit at the right edge. Event documentation, as the curator graded comparable aerials.

frames.subject: Catering staff carrying serving bowls to a white-clothed table
frames.reason: Staff in chef's blacks and a hairnet, a card-payment terminal on the table and service platters — catering operations documentation, the opposite of the register wanted.

frames.subject: Dining table with blue napkins set under a yellow canopy beside a pool
frames.reason: Harsh midday light, an amateur wide phone frame with a beer bottle in someone's hand intruding at the bottom-left corner, folding chairs cutting across the foreground and canopy poles bisecting the view.

frames.subject: White gate frame opening onto a pool terrace between palm trees
frames.reason: Clean, deliberate symmetry through the gateway with palms either side, but the sky is a large flat midday void, a bare-chested guest stands at the right edge and staff cluster at the bar on the left. Solid support frame.

frames.subject: Guests dining at tables under festoon lights with a lit pool and the sea beyond
frames.reason: Warm dusk sky and strung lights give real atmosphere and the pool and sea place it well, but it is crowded with white folding chairs and backs of heads and shot from a plain standing eye level. Good support.

frames.subject: Server holding a platter of bruschetta beside a bowl of pasta salad
frames.reason: Cropped catering hands-and-tray detail with no property context; food-service documentation, and the background is a blown-out blur.

frames.subject: Guests ordering at a thatched timber bar stocked with spirits
frames.reason: A black PA speaker on a tripod with cabling stands at the left, a shirtless guest in swim shorts is the main figure, and the light is flat. Snapshot of a service moment, not editorial.

frames.subject: Blue-lit pool at dusk with festoon lights reflected in the water and guests beyond
frames.reason: The strung lights reflecting as points across the water are a nice touch and the dusk sky is soft, but the far side is a cluttered mix of tents, umbrellas and distant buildings and a guest is caught walking out of the bottom-left corner.

frames.subject: Sun setting behind a distant headland over calm sea, tall reeds silhouetted in the foreground
frames.reason: The only frame in this batch with hero light and no defect: a smooth pink-to-peach gradient, the sun disc sitting clean on a soft blue cape, silver ripple texture on the water, and a simple two-part composition with the reed silhouette anchoring the left and open sky and sea carrying the right. No clutter, no cropped object, no cable — and the empty right half takes type. I part company with Grader One here: the reeds read as a deliberate graphic mass, not untidiness, and the softness is atmospheric haze at sunset rather than a technical fault. Full-bleed capable.

frames.subject: Three labelled glass drink dispensers on a white table with trailing ivy
frames.reason: Catering set-up detail against a completely blown-out white background, dressed with artificial plastic ivy; an ice bucket of beer bottles crowds the right edge.

frames.subject: Small aerial of white villas and a pool on a seafront plot, with an award badge overlaid
frames.reason: A travel-award seal is burned into the top-left corner of the frame, and the file itself is tiny and soft at 400 pixels wide — unusable at any size, quite apart from the overlay.
frames.flagReason: Carries a third-party Conde Nast Traveler award badge burned into the image, so it is not clean property imagery.

frames.subject: Aerial of white villas and gardens on a seafront plot above a deep blue sea
frames.reason: Strong, legible establishing view with a superb blue sea, but ploughed brown fields, dirt tracks and a tarmac apron with parked cars take up much of the lower and right frame, and telegraph poles cross it. Useful orientation image, not a hero.

frames.subject: Aerial showing villas and pools beside a tarmac apron marked with a yellow helipad H
frames.reason: The helipad tarmac and bare dirt fields dominate the frame while the villas are pushed into a corner; the file is also small and soft. Reads as a site survey, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Row of black and white Mercedes vans and a saloon parked on a waterfront with a town behind
frames.reason: Parked transfer vehicles on an asphalt lot with number plates blacked out and a hillside town across the water — a supplier fleet shot, flat light, no estate in frame.
frames.flagReason: Shot on a public town waterfront car park with a townscape behind, not on the estate; shows third-party branded vehicles.

frames.subject: Open-plan living room and kitchen with a brown sofa, wooden table and staircase
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits high in the frame at left — the curator's named reject — with a wall TV, microwave, coffee machines and a dishwasher panel adding appliance clutter along the kitchen run.

frames.subject: Pool terrace and parasol seen through open sliding doors from a dining room
frames.reason: Real and usable interior-to-pool frame with clean turquoise water and bright sky, but the right third is eaten by a dark door frame and reflective glass, the flower vase crowds the edge, and the midday light is flat. Support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: White kitchen and dining table with a wall-mounted air-conditioning unit
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit high on the wall at upper left, plus a speaker box, a rainbow knife block and a cluttered worktop; the composition is split awkwardly between kitchen run and dining nook. Exactly the AC-and-clutter reject the standard names.

frames.subject: White bed with folded bathrobes facing a sea-view balcony door
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit prominent at top right, with a thermostat, socket bank and cable clutter down the left wall; the bed is cropped hard at three edges. The sea slot through the door is nice but the utility clutter rejects it.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a washbasin and bathtub, bedroom visible through the door
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: the basin is sliced off by the bottom edge, a soap dish is half in frame at lower left, and the open door cuts the composition in two. Flat bounced light, no hero quality.

frames.subject: Twin bedroom with a wooden headboard, white wardrobe wall and a window onto greenery
frames.reason: Straight, correctly exposed, genuinely usable as room documentation — the timber floor, headboard and garden window all read well. Support only: the blank white wardrobe slab eats the left third, a blue and white textile is cut off in the bottom left corner, another object intrudes at the far left edge, and the light is flat fill. Compositionally weak, but none of it is C-list defect — this is a real room shot, not a snapshot.

frames.subject: Covered terrace off an open-plan kitchen looking onto a turquoise pool and lawn
frames.reason: Does real work: it shows the indoor-outdoor relationship in one frame, the pool water and deep blue sky are clean, and the architecture is tidy. Not full bleed — a black chair back is sliced off dead centre along the bottom edge, another is clipped at the bottom right, chairs and the coffee table clutter the middle, and a thin overhead cable crosses the small gap of sky in the passage. The cable is minor and croppable rather than disqualifying.

frames.subject: Bright kitchen and dining table with folding doors open to a sunlit terrace
frames.reason: The room itself is airy and well ordered, with a strong line through the open doors to the terrace and clean symmetry around the oak table. Support only: a filter coffee machine fills the left foreground, a microwave and a stacked pan sit on top of the fridge, the exterior is blown out, and the light is ordinary daylight. The service corner is confined to the left edge, so this stays usable rather than rejected.

frames.subject: Outdoor dining table set with wine beside a barbecue counter and timber fence
frames.reason: Real dressed-terrace frame with a strong blue sky and a centred table, but the light is hard midday with black shadows, a laminated notice hangs on the fence at right, and a bean bag and pool edge crowd the corner. Usable, not hero.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool and loungers in front of a white villa, power lines overhead
frames.reason: Power lines and a utility pole cross the sky at upper left, a blue lounger is cut in half by the left edge, and a neighbouring building sits in the top right. Cables and utility poles are named rejects.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub set into a wooden deck with a rolled towel on the rim
frames.reason: Tight crop with no context at all. The moulded acrylic tub shell and its control pad dominate, a strip of artificial turf runs along the top — the same cheap register the standard rejects — and a black wheeled piece of equipment intrudes into the top right corner. The water texture is attractive but it is carrying a frame with nothing else in it.

frames.subject: Pool terrace overlooking a dry field with utility poles and overhead cables
frames.reason: Two utility poles and a web of overhead cables sit across the middle of the frame, an air-conditioning condenser is visible beside the barbecue counter, and the outlook is a parched brown field. Multiple named defects at once.

frames.subject: Bedroom with a brown quilted bedspread and an air-conditioning unit above the bed
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit large at top right, a bottle lying on its side on the bed, a blank white wall filling the left half and a mean slot window. Flat light and utility clutter.

frames.subject: Upper terrace with a small table and chair facing the sea horizon
frames.reason: Genuine sea horizon and strong blue, and the glass balustrade reads well, but half the frame is empty pale paving, a heavy white column splits it, and overhead wires thread the sky at left. Real and usable, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Pool and hot tub behind a stone wall with the sea beyond
frames.reason: Handsome layered frame — pool, stone wall, sea — with good colour and a tidy deck, but the light is flat overhead noon, the horizon is bleached to almost nothing, and a neighbouring building and cable sit at the right. Strong support.

frames.subject: Pool and timber deck with towel-draped loungers, sea and a utility pole beyond
frames.reason: A utility pole with strung cables stands centre frame above the stone wall, and the foreground is a jumble of loungers cropped by the bottom and right edges with a magazine left on one. Pole and cables are named rejects.

frames.subject: Open-plan living room and kitchen with a sofa, dining table and wall-mounted TV
frames.reason: Clean, bright and honest room documentation, but flat frontal light, a black subwoofer box parked on the floor at right and a busy wall of TV, shelf and pictures keep it well short of hero.

frames.subject: Pool, stone wall and blue sea seen from a living room through open glass doors
frames.reason: Nicely layered inside-out view with a clean stone wall and a real sea band, the best interior frame here, but the right third is a blank wall with spotted cushions, the sky is blown white and a thin post breaks the wall line. Support.

frames.subject: Bedroom with a fruit and sparkling wine tray on the bed and a terrace door
frames.reason: Warm wood floor and a welcoming dressed bed with usable daylight from the terrace door, but the bed is cropped at the right edge, the left wall shelf is dead space and the light is flat. Good support.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub on a deck with the sea horizon beyond a stone wall
frames.reason: Real sea horizon, deep blue sky and a dressed tub with a chilled bottle, but the parasol chops the top left corner, a lounger is cut off at the bottom left, and the light is hard midday with a bleached horizon.

frames.subject: White bed beneath butterfly wall art with folded towels and a wooden headboard
frames.reason: Symmetrical, tidy and well exposed, a solid catalogue frame, but the bathrobes are sliced by the bottom edge, the light is flat and even, and there is no view, depth or atmosphere to carry a full bleed.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a corner spa bath, washbasin and WC
frames.reason: The WC and its brush sit centre-left in frame with a wall bidet hose beside them; the composition is a wide sweep of fixtures under flat light. Clutter in the register the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Paved path winding between white villas and planted gardens towards the sea
frames.reason: Clean leading line through the planting to a glimpse of sea, real estate grounds and no clutter, but the top half is empty blue sky, the noon light is flat and the planting is still thin. Usable support.

frames.subject: Wooden swing set and slide on green rubber matting beside a trampoline
frames.reason: Wooden playground on artificial matting with a trampoline and stacked white patio chairs behind — the curator rejected this exact subject as reading like a family park rather than a luxury villa.

frames.subject: Breakfast tables laid under an orange shade sail with gardens, white villas and a strip of sea beyond
frames.reason: The orange sail takes the whole top third and throws a heavy warm cast over everything below it. The foreground is a rank of empty white mesh chairs cut by the bottom edge, the furniture is perforated metal cafe stock rather than villa furniture, coloured recycling bins line up beside the villa at right, and a green trampoline net cuts the left edge. Reads as breakfast service, not editorial.

frames.subject: Breakfast table crowded with bread, cold cuts, eggs, jam jars and juice
frames.reason: Cluttered buffet spread with branded jam jars, a coffee capsule, a plastic-wrapped condiment pile and a cardboard menu block; shallow focus, no property context at all. Snapshot of catering, not editorial.
frames.flagReason: Tight food spread with nothing of the estate in frame — indistinguishable from generic hotel-breakfast stock; confirm it was shot on site before use.

frames.subject: Cars parked under carports on a paved driveway beside a white villa
frames.reason: Parked cars with visible number plates fill the middle distance, a grey service cabinet and gate post block the right third, and the foreground is a large empty expanse of paving. Service area, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Whitewashed villa at dusk with an LED-lit staircase and a glowing pool
frames.reason: Easily the best light in the batch — pink-to-blue gradient, blue-lit stair, uplit pool, expensive-looking marble and white cube architecture. I stop short of Grader One's A because it is not full-bleed capable as shot: a utility pole with four or five wires stands against the pink sky at the left and more wire crosses the sky at right, and the entire bottom edge is a scatter of white lounger frames cut by three edges with magazines and a towel left on them. Crop and retouch would make it hero; as it stands it is a strong B.

frames.subject: Playground swing set and slide on rubber matting in front of white villas
frames.reason: Playground on artificial matting again, with overhead power lines crossing the top left corner, a utility pole beyond the fence and a blue plastic drum at right. Playground plus cables — two named rejects.

frames.subject: Illuminated estate entrance sign lettered Thalasses beside a driveway at dusk
frames.reason: Genuine blue-hour light with lit paving and a warm horizon glow, and it unambiguously identifies the estate, but half the frame is a flat backlit yellow signboard and the rest is empty driveway. Wayfinding image, not a hero.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a rocky shore above turquoise water
frames.reason: The best sea colour in the set and a real organised shoreline with a boardwalk, but the light is flat midday rather than the golden hour the A beach frames have, and wooden steps and a wicker bin clutter the bottom corners.

frames.subject: Living and dining room opening to a pool terrace with the sea beyond
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit on the wall at upper right and a wall-mounted TV sliced by the top left corner with its bracket exposed; the view through to the pool is good but the utility clutter frames it on both sides.

frames.subject: Pool, lawn and seating terrace enclosed by a stone wall with the sea behind
frames.reason: Coherent wide view with pool, lawn, stone wall and a real sea band, and the white villa wall gives it structure, but chairs are cropped hard along the bottom edge and the light is hard midday with a washed-out horizon.

frames.subject: White villa exterior with a turquoise pool, lawn loungers and a parasol under midday sun
frames.reason: Clean architecture and good pool colour, but hard overhead midday light with flat white walls, a lounger cropped through the bottom edge and a staged bowl of grapes; neighbouring rooftops sit at the left horizon. Real and usable, not full-bleed.

frames.subject: Terrace with a parasol and pool above a stone wall, open sea beyond
frames.reason: Sells the sea-facing terrace and the water reads well, but the light is harsh midday, white chairs are cropped at three edges, a rolled blue towel is dumped on the table and thin overhead lines cross the sky above the boundary wall.

frames.subject: Close-up of a sun lounger with a blue towel beside a pool edge
frames.reason: Snapshot framing with no clear subject: the lounger is cut through the middle of the frame, chrome pool handrails and an orange lifebuoy compete in the blurred background, and the crop reads as a leftover detail rather than an image.

frames.subject: Bright white living room with a teal sofa and sliding doors onto a terrace
frames.reason: Legible, well-lit interior showing the lounge and its terrace access, but a wall-mounted TV is cropped into the top-right corner, dark vessels crowd the right edge and half the frame is blank wall. Support-grade documentation only.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and dining area with a mint retro fridge and a teal sofa
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit sits high on the wall in the upper centre of frame, which the standard rejects outright; the rest is a competent but flat interior record.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen with a mint retro fridge, a pineapple in a green bowl and a carved bird on the counter
frames.reason: Deliberately styled — the pineapple, green bowl and mint fridge are a real colour idea — and cleanly exposed with warm under-cabinet light. Filler only: a white chair back is cropped dead centre and blocks the table, a microwave is stacked on top of the fridge with a toaster and blender on the counter behind, a blank white wall splits the right third, and the light is flat interior fill. Same tier as the other kitchen frame, so it takes the same grade.

frames.subject: Bedroom with a white bed, folded robes and doors to a walled terrace
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit is mounted centre-top above the bed, the named reject condition; the folded robes and cushions also read as generic rental styling.

frames.subject: Outdoor wine cooler in a wooden cabinet with wine glasses blurred in the foreground
frames.reason: A utility appliance is the subject, centre frame, with its manufacturer wordmark legible; the bottom third is an empty out-of-focus counter and the glasses are unreadably soft. Appliance documentation, not property imagery.
frames.flagReason: Frame is dominated by a branded appliance with the maker's logo legible and carries no property context beyond a fence, so it reads like third-party product imagery.

frames.subject: Vegetable garden in hard sunlight with a crate of tomatoes and courgettes in the foreground
frames.reason: Documentary farm frame: dry bare soil, an irrigation hose snaking across the ground, blown midday light and the produce crate awkwardly cropped at the bottom-left corner. Reads as a smallholding, not a luxury villa.

frames.subject: A painted beach signpost beside a gravel track running down to the sea
frames.reason: Wire mesh fencing, scrubby verge, gravel and harsh flat midday light; the sign fills the frame and the sea is a thin strip. Wayfinding record, not editorial imagery.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining space with sliding doors framing a blue sea view
frames.reason: The sea view through the doors is the frame's strength, but an air-conditioning unit sits on the wall above the dining table, which the standard rejects; a kettle, dishwasher and appliances also clutter the left foreground.

frames.subject: Aerial of a poolside evening party with round dining tables and a thatched bar
frames.reason: Event documentation exactly in the register the curator graded B: busy with guests, catering tables and equipment, dusk light, and the file is a small low-resolution frame that could not carry a full bleed.

frames.subject: Aerial of a small wedding ceremony on a sandy cove beside clear turquoise water
frames.reason: Genuinely attractive water and a strong diagonal shoreline, but overhead midday light flattens it, guests read as specks and a large area of empty sand dominates the lower half. Good support, not hero.

frames.subject: Overhead aerial of guests gathered in a circle on a paved garden path
frames.reason: Flat top-down snapshot with no readable subject; the lawn shows brown scorched patches and bare earth beds, the people are unrecognisable specks and the light is dull. Event record at best.

frames.subject: Aerial of white villas beside the sea at golden hour, farmland in the foreground
frames.reason: Useful establishing frame with warm low light on the water, but a car park full of vehicles sits centre-right, ploughed fields and a dirt track fill the foreground, and utility poles with lines run down the left side.

frames.subject: A couple at a floral wedding arch on the beach with the sea behind
frames.reason: Warm and real, cleanly centred, but the sky is blown to white haze, the light is flat midday and the celebrant's figure at the left edge unbalances the frame. Portrait crop limits full-bleed use.

frames.subject: A couple in wedding clothes walking a paved garden path toward the camera
frames.reason: Warm low sun and a real sense of the grounds, but people-led and posed, with a large empty sky filling the top half and a utility pole and wires visible over the hedge line. Support, in the register the curator graded B.

frames.subject: Long dinner table of guests under a shade sail in a garden
frames.reason: Power cables cut across a blown-white sky, banquet chairs are dressed in slip covers, a children's slide and a drinks trolley clutter the left, and the light is flat. Catering-and-cables reject.

frames.subject: Wine glasses and a board of mezze dishes on a wooden table
frames.reason: Generic food photography with a blurred green background, no property signature at all, and a small soft low-resolution file that could not be used large.
frames.flagReason: Reads as commercial food stock — a styled mezze board with no identifiable property context, supplied as a small web-sized asset.

frames.subject: Wine barrel, bottles, glasses and grapes on a table against a vineyard sunset
frames.reason: Obvious composite commercial product shot with an implausibly saturated sky; nothing of the property is in frame and the file is small and soft.
frames.flagReason: Classic commercial wine stock composite set in a vineyard; there is no vineyard at a seafront estate and no property element in frame.

frames.subject: Two silhouetted figures meditating on grass against a sunset sky
frames.reason: Generic wellness stock in exactly the mould of the cyclist frames the curator rejected: silhouettes, an anonymous grass horizon, nothing of the property, and a tiny low-resolution file.
frames.flagReason: Anonymous yoga-at-sunset silhouettes on a featureless grass horizon; a standard stock wellness trope with no property content.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a private beach beside turquoise water
frames.reason: The water colour and the rocky cove are excellent, but the light is flat midday rather than golden, empty blue sky takes the top half, and a wooden deck corner intrudes into the bottom-left. Strong support, short of the golden-hour hero frames.

frames.subject: Villa terrace at dusk with a green-lit pool and a warmly lit interior beyond
frames.reason: Good blue-hour colour and controlled interior glow, but a chrome pool ladder cuts across the foreground right, a drainpipe runs down the wall behind the seating, and a utility pole with cables and a parked car sit in the left background.

frames.subject: High aerial of a coastline with white villas, farmland and deep blue sea
frames.reason: Excellent sea colour and a genuinely useful location frame, but it is a survey view: ploughed brown fields, a main road, a bare construction plot and distant town sprawl take most of the land side, and the sky is hazy.

frames.subject: Aerial of a poolside evening reception with dining tables, palms and the sea behind
frames.reason: Handsome dusk colour and palms reflected in the pool, but it is event documentation — dressed tables, staff, guests mid-frame, a bar and parked cars along the right edge. Matches the curator's B event aerials.

frames.subject: Chalkboard sign reading self service soft drinks and iced tea beside an ice bucket and glasses
frames.reason: Catering gear as the subject: a galvanised ice bucket, stacked tumblers and a handwritten service sign with plastic ivy. The opposite of the register the standard asks for.

frames.subject: A man in a straw hat kneeling on the grass filling a wooden crate with courgettes
frames.reason: Phone-snapshot documentary in the same mould as the rejected gardener frame: harsh midday shadows, scorched patchy lawn, overhead cables and a pole across the sky at the top-left, and a road and parked vehicles behind the hedge.

frames.subject: Palms mirrored in a lit pool at dusk with the sea and a pastel sky beyond
frames.reason: The reflection and pastel afterglow are genuinely cinematic, but a guest strikes a pose in the centre of the shot, a pink-lit drinks table and a marquee clutter the flanks, and the file is soft and noisy. Strong support, not hero.

frames.subject: Lit villa at dusk with a green-glowing pool and timber deck
frames.reason: Deep blue-hour sky, warm interior light and the green-lit pool make this the best-lit villa frame in the batch, but a zoom on the left edge shows an outdoor shower head and arm cutting across the sky, taps and a coiled green garden hose on the post below it. A black wire chair sits in the foreground and a white foam float is left lying on the deck. Real and expensive-looking, but too much utility clutter along the left third for full bleed.

frames.subject: Buffet trays of grilled meat, rice and potatoes on dressed catering tables
frames.reason: Stainless chafing dishes with serving spoons dominate the frame — the exact reject the curator named — plus a PA speaker on a stand, a folding table and staff behind.

frames.subject: Guests ordering at a thatched outdoor bar stocked with spirit bottles
frames.reason: Cluttered snapshot: a PA speaker and trailing cables at the left, a shirtless guest in swim shorts centre frame, backs to the camera and flat bright light. Reads as a holiday snap, not editorial.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a wooden headboard, ceiling fan and doors to a walled garden
frames.reason: Clean, bright and free of the usual clutter, with warm floors and a tidy bed, but the composition is slack — a broad empty wall through the centre, wall art clipped at the right edge and a fruit tray staged on the duvet. Solid support frame.

frames.subject: Dressed banquet tables around a seafront pool with palms and string lights
frames.reason: Real event documentation with the pool centred and a clean sea horizon, but the sky is blown flat white, the lower band is dead concrete and the terrace is busy with guests and equipment. Usable support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Buffet chafing dishes of grilled meat and rice on white-clothed tables outdoors
frames.reason: Catering equipment fills the frame, exactly the register the standard excludes; a PA speaker on a stand, utility poles and overhead wires clutter the background.

frames.subject: Wooden swing frame, slide and trampoline on green rubber safety matting
frames.reason: Reads as a family park rather than a luxury villa; hard midday light, wide-angle distortion and a green rubber floor dominating the frame.

frames.subject: Beach wedding ceremony beneath a draped floral arch at the water's edge
frames.reason: Real and warm, sells the wedding story, but the light is flat and hazy, the sky is blown white and the top half of the vertical frame is empty. Support, not hero.

frames.subject: Private pool terrace with a parasol, loungers and the sea beyond a stone wall
frames.reason: Shows the product honestly with sea and pool in one frame, but it is hard midday light, the foreground table and chairs are cut off at the bottom edge, and a life ring and a power line over the wall break the picture.

frames.subject: Palms reflected in a lit pool at dusk with a figure silhouetted against the sea
frames.reason: Genuinely lovely blue-hour reflection and sunset gradient, but the star-pose figure is a snapshot moment and the left edge carries loungers, bags and a pink-lit table. Close to hero, held back by the clutter.

frames.subject: Dressed banquet tables at a poolside reception under festoon lights
frames.reason: Genuinely attractive event coverage — a well-dressed foreground table with glassware and teal runners, festoon lights giving the top of the frame structure, palms and the sea behind. Kept off hero by a sky blown to flat white with no tone left in it, a black pushchair in the left corner, a PA speaker on a stand at the right and guests scattered mid-frame. Usable support for a weddings page, never a hero.

frames.subject: Staff in white shirts carrying platters of stuffed mushrooms and pasta salad
frames.reason: Catering gear and cropped torsos with no property context at all; shallow-focus service documentation.

frames.subject: Living room with a teal sofa and sliding doors onto a terrace
frames.reason: A crop of the top-left corner confirms a white split air-conditioning indoor unit, louvre and display visible, sliced by the frame edge — the curator's named reject. Beyond that the wall TV is cut by the top edge, dark ceramics and a fruit bowl are cropped hard into the bottom-right corner, a large dead white wall fills the left half and the light is flat unmodelled fill. AC unit plus snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Two safari jeeps on a mountain dirt track past grazing sheep under a heavy sky
frames.reason: Heavily processed generic excursion imagery with nothing of the property in frame; the same category as the cyclist frames the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: Generic off-road excursion photograph on an inland mountain track with no property feature visible; reads as bought-in activity stock used to illustrate jeep safaris.

frames.subject: Aerial view of a seafront pool terrace with fields, a dirt track and the beach
frames.reason: Harsh top-down midday light, and most of the frame is bare tilled brown earth, dirt track and cars parked in the scrub; the pool terrace is a small patch at centre. Useful as a site map, but as imagery it reads as farmland — the same register as the curator's rejected gardener-in-a-field frame.

frames.subject: Bride and groom walking hand in hand along a paved garden path
frames.reason: Warm low light and a real moment on the grounds, but people-led with the top half of the frame empty sky and a pole and wire visible over the shrubs. Same register the curator graded B for the garden-path family.

frames.subject: Poolside reception tables with guests walking past a pool and palms
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other reception frame and weaker in every respect: completely blown white sky, a black pushchair in the left corner, an orange traffic cone by the pool, a guest in swim shorts walking through the middle of the shot and a wide slab of empty grey concrete filling the bottom right. Nothing here the better frame does not do more cleanly.

frames.subject: Thatched straw umbrellas and white loungers on a shingle beach above turquoise water
frames.reason: Punchy colour and the real private beach, but hard midday sun rather than the golden light the A frames have, and the composition is unresolved: the top umbrella is cropped and looming, a sunbed edge intrudes bottom-left.

frames.subject: Coloured floor cushions along curved terrace steps above a seafront pool
frames.reason: Distinctive space and a nice run of colour leading the eye to the sea, but the sky is flat white and a large expanse of stained grey concrete takes the foreground. Real and usable, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Open timber gate framing a pool, palms and a poolside bar
frames.reason: Deliberate symmetry and warm evening light, but the bottom third is bare rough concrete, the sky is empty, and a utility pole with wires stands behind the bar at left.

frames.subject: Guests at a long dinner table under a beige shade sail beside a playground slide
frames.reason: Power lines and a utility pole run straight across a blown-out white sky, a playground slide sits behind the table, and the vertical frame is mostly empty sky. Named defects, straight C.

frames.subject: Empty dressed banquet tables on a concrete terrace in low evening sun
frames.reason: Warm backlight and clean table styling make this the best of the event set-up frames, but the sky is blank white and the foreground is a wide sweep of plain concrete with guests in swimwear at the edge.

frames.subject: Villa terrace with a private pool, lawn loungers and the sea beyond a stone wall
frames.reason: Clean, well-exposed property photography showing pool, lawn and sea together, but it is midday listing-agent work: half the frame is empty blue sky, a chair is cut by the right edge and an orange life ring sits on the grass.

frames.subject: Breakfast table laid with breads, jams, cheeses, eggs and orange juice
frames.reason: Cluttered close-up with a white card box dead centre, sugar and butter sachets and a coffee capsule among the plates; shallow focus and no property context.

frames.subject: Golden-hour aerial of white villas with private pools above the sea
frames.reason: Warm evening light on the sea and a genuinely useful overview of the estate, but a car park full of vehicles, a ploughed field across the bottom third and power poles and wires bottom-left keep it out of hero territory.

frames.subject: Chalkboard sign reading Self Service beside an ice bucket and coloured glasses
frames.reason: Catering service detail with no property context, plastic ivy in the foreground and a busy shallow-focus background. Not property imagery.

frames.subject: Person in a sun hat kneeling among young plantings in a dry field by the sea
frames.reason: Documentary frame that reads as a farm plot, not a villa garden; wires cross the sky, the ground is bare dirt and the picture has the soft, tilted look of a phone snapshot.

frames.subject: Kitchen counter with a pineapple in a green bowl and a mint-green fridge
frames.reason: Tidy, symmetrical and the retro fridge gives it some charm, but it is flat interior light, appliance-led (microwave, blender, toaster, alarm box on the wall) and a chair is cut off at the bottom edge.

frames.subject: Sun setting over the sea behind a screen of tall reeds
frames.reason: Soft pink-to-amber gradient, the sun disc sitting on a distant cape and a silver sea give this real atmosphere and it leaves the right half open for type. But it is hazy and low in contrast, and the reeds filling the left half are a dark undifferentiated tangle rather than a clean silhouette, so the composition never resolves. Beautiful support, short of hero.
frames.flagReason: A generic sea sunset with no identifiable estate feature — plausibly shot from the shore here, but nothing in frame confirms it is this property rather than anywhere on the coast.

frames.subject: Guests dancing on a concrete pool terrace at dusk under string lights
frames.reason: Candid snapshot with everyone caught mid-step in unflattering poses, a blown-out white sky and the lower half of the frame given over to bare grey concrete.

frames.subject: Man in a white shirt pouring a drink into a glass carafe outdoors
frames.reason: Overhead wires cut across the sky behind him, a bare tree trunk and a second man are cropped at the frame edges, and a cable and handle intrude bottom-right. Service snapshot, no property in frame.

frames.subject: Couple at a white-clothed table on the shore with the sea and coastline behind
frames.reason: Warm, real and sells private dining by the water, but the woman's back is to camera and blocks her companion's face, and a second dressed table crowds the left edge. Good support, not a hero.

frames.subject: Dining table with a turquoise vase and chairs, bedroom visible through a doorway
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit high on the wall centre-frame, a black speaker box on the floor, a TV cropped at the top edge and power cables outside the window. The standard's named AC-and-utility-clutter reject.

frames.subject: Dressed banquet tables around a seafront pool with palms and string lights
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the earlier pool-event frame and no stronger: the pool and sea horizon read well, but the sky is blown flat white and the terrace is busy with guests, tripods and a pushchair. Usable support only.

frames.subject: Bathroom with marble tiling, a walk-in shower and an oval vessel basin
frames.reason: Wall-hung toilet with a folded cloth on the lid sits dead centre with a toilet brush beside it; flat interior light and wide-angle distortion pull the walls out. Functional listing frame, not editorial.
frames.flagReason: The rolled towel in the foreground carries another company's brand name (coco-mat) legibly across it, so the frame shows third-party branding rather than the estate's own.

frames.subject: Lit villa exteriors at dusk along a paved path, with recycling bins in the foreground
frames.reason: The dusk architecture and sunset gradient are close to hero light, but three coloured recycling bins sit in the left foreground of the frame. Utility clutter, the same defect that rejected the hot tub with the AC unit behind it.

frames.subject: Aerial view of a wedding set-up on a sandy cove beside rocky shallows
frames.reason: Beautiful clear turquoise water and clean sand, but harsh overhead midday light with hard shadows, guests scattered loosely across the middle of the frame and a dark equipment case on the sand at lower left; event documentation rather than hero material.

frames.subject: White open-plan kitchen and dining table under black wire pendant lamps
frames.reason: Clean, bright, well-styled interior with olive branches and ceramics, but the light is flat diffuse daylight, the bench is cropped hard at the bottom edge and the right-hand shelving wall is busy; good support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Two branded toiletry bottles and a soap beside a white basin
frames.reason: Tight product close-up with no property context, awkward off-centre placement, a mostly empty basin dominating the frame and third-party cosmetic branding on the labels; reads as generic amenity/stock photography.
frames.flagReason: Another company's product branding fills the frame and there is nothing of the estate visible to confirm it was shot on site.

frames.subject: Man in a black T-shirt drawing a cork from a wine bottle at an outdoor counter
frames.reason: Headless torso crop, snapshot framing, and grey and blue plastic bins stacked behind the subject at left; utility clutter and no sense of place.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and sun loungers on a sandy shore with turquoise sea
frames.reason: Real private-shore content with lovely water colour, but hard midday light, a large featureless expanse of blue sky, and a cluttered foreground of scrub, timber decking and a rolled lounger cover; usable support, not the golden-hour version.

frames.subject: Stone lighthouse and harbour wall framed through a yellow-walled arch
frames.reason: Genuinely nice frame-within-a-frame with warm light on the stone arch, but the sky is dull and cloud-flat, a green signboard intrudes at the left edge and a chain lies across the foreground paving; competent area content at best.
frames.flagReason: This is a public Venetian harbour lighthouse and quayside in town, not the estate.

frames.subject: Wooden signpost reading thalasses BEACH beside a gravel track and wire fencing
frames.reason: Wayfinding signage shot: green plastic mesh fencing runs down the right side, the track is weedy gravel, the light is hard midday and the sign slab covers the best part of the frame. Snapshot, not editorial.

frames.subject: Corner of a small kitchen with sink, coffee capsule machine and oven
frames.reason: Cluttered worktop with a bright purple plastic bowl, rainbow knife block, blue plastic tray and appliance boxes; awkward crop of the cabinet run and flat under-cabinet lighting.

frames.subject: Green-lit pool and terrace beside a white villa at dusk
frames.reason: Overhead power cables and a utility pole cross the dusk sky dead centre frame, and a cushion and blue towels on a lounger are cropped into the bottom-right corner; the named cable-and-pole defect kills an otherwise pretty blue-hour scene.

frames.subject: Timber outdoor shower on a lawn at the edge of a deep blue sea
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: the dark brown shower block is cropped hard along the right edge and dominates, green construction netting is visible behind it, the lawn is patchy and half the frame is empty midday sky.

frames.subject: Stethoscope and a ballpoint pen lying on a printed medical form
frames.reason: Generic medical stock still life with no connection whatsoever to a villa estate; nothing of the property in frame.
frames.flagReason: Standard commercial stock imagery of a stethoscope on a clinical form, unrelated to the property.

frames.subject: Bright white twin bedroom with wooden headboard, ceiling fan and a green garden view
frames.reason: Clean and real listing-grade interior with a nice window view, but flat light, a slightly wide-angle standard framing, rolled towels dumped on the bed and a dark blue chair intruding into the bottom-left corner.

frames.subject: Villa terrace at dusk with a green-lit pool behind a stone wall
frames.reason: Good blue-hour light, warm door and wall lights against white render and a green-lit pool leading the eye in. Held back by a power line sagging across the sky above the wall, an orange life ring hanging on the stonework, grey sling loungers cropped across the bottom-left corner and white furniture sliced by the right edge. Strong support, not clean enough for full bleed.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate on a wall beside a doorway with a pool blurred behind
frames.reason: Almost the entire frame is out of focus, a gold door jamb splits the composition down the middle and the only sharp element is a small sign; misfocused snapshot.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a large bed, blue cushions and a glazed door to a terrace
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit in the top-left corner of the frame, plus laundry-style robes and towels piled on the bedspread and a very empty white wall through the middle; the AC unit alone is a reject by the standard.

frames.subject: Carved stone fountain and vaulted archway in an old-town lane
frames.reason: Flat overcast light, a jumble of terracotta pots along the foreground, a shop sign, a wall-mounted camera and overhead wires top left; documentary snapshot of a monument.
frames.flagReason: A public old-town fountain and street, not the estate grounds.

frames.subject: Paved forecourt with parked cars under carports beside a white villa
frames.reason: Parked cars and canopy carports fill the right of the frame and a vast empty paved driveway fills the bottom half; a grey utility view with a metal gate post cropped across the right edge.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining area opening through folding doors onto a sunlit terrace
frames.reason: Real, airy and usable, but the left third is stacked with appliances including a microwave with a pan on top and a filter coffee machine, the terrace beyond is blown out to white, and a sofa is cropped into the bottom corner.

frames.subject: White kitchen with a mint retro fridge and a wooden table set with a pineapple
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit prominent at top right of frame; also a rainbow knife block and worktop appliance clutter. The AC unit is a named reject.

frames.subject: Outdoor wine fridge in a plywood cabinet with blurred wine glasses in front
frames.reason: A large blank plywood door occupies the centre of the frame, a cloth is draped inside the fridge, and the foreground counter and glasses are thrown so far out of focus they read as a mistake rather than a choice.

frames.subject: A sunbather's legs on a boat deck above the wake and open sea
frames.reason: Classic point-of-view holiday stock trope with nothing of the property in frame; blown-out water highlights and a cropped tender at the left edge.
frames.flagReason: Generic lifestyle boating stock; no estate content visible and impossible to attribute to this property.

frames.subject: Guests ordering at a thatched timber bar stocked with spirit bottles
frames.reason: Event documentation: a PA speaker on a stand and its cabling sit at the left of the bar, a chalkboard menu and stacked crockery clutter the counter, a shirtless guest stands centre frame and the composition is flatly frontal.

frames.subject: Wooden signpost reading thalasses BEACH beside a gravel track and wire fencing
frames.reason: Exact duplicate of the earlier signpost frame; same defects, green plastic mesh fencing, weedy gravel track, hard midday light and a sign slab blocking the view.

frames.subject: Timber outdoor shower on a lawn at the edge of a deep blue sea
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the earlier shower frame and no stronger: the dark shower block is cropped against the right edge, green netting shows behind it and a large empty band of midday sky fills the top half.

frames.subject: Bedroom with a caramel quilted bedspread and purple LED cove lighting
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit at top left of frame, purple LED strip lighting that reads dated and cheap, and towels folded on the bed like a turndown record shot.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool and sun lounger looking out over the sea
frames.reason: A utility pole and its power cables run straight across the sea horizon at centre, and cars are parked on the road immediately behind the wall. An orange life ring hangs on the stonework and the top half is empty blue sky. Lovely water colour, but poles and cables in frame are the named reject.

frames.subject: Sun setting over the sea beyond a dark scrub shoreline
frames.reason: Hazy, low-contrast light with no separation left in the sky, and a murky undifferentiated band of dark shoreline scrub with a dead branch running across the bottom third. No subject and nothing of the property — a generic sunset snapshot.
frames.flagReason: Nothing of the estate is visible; plausibly the adjacent coast but equally reads as a generic sunset frame.

frames.subject: Round table dressed for dinner beside a pool at sunset, guests sitting at the water's edge
frames.reason: Warm low light and an attractive blue-and-white table setting that sells the wedding story, but two plastic water bottles stand centre table, the background washes out to near-white haze and the tablecloth is cut off at the bottom edge; event coverage, not hero.

frames.subject: Illuminated estate entrance wall with the thalasses logo at dusk
frames.reason: Handsome blue-hour gradient with a warm sunset band and good uplighting on the paving, but the subject is a branded signage wall and an empty driveway fills the lower half; strong support, reads as a signage frame rather than a hero.

frames.subject: Aerial view of white villas and landscaped gardens with the sea behind
frames.reason: The best establishing frame of the batch, showing the layout and how close the sea sits, but utility poles and wires cross the left foreground, cars sit under the carports at right, bare dusty ground surrounds the plot and the horizon is hazy.

frames.subject: Aerial view of villas between a concrete helipad and ploughed fields by the sea
frames.reason: Roughly half the frame is bare ploughed farmland and dusty concrete with a painted helipad marking, wires and poles run through the lower right, and the villas are pushed into a small band of the middle; reads as a site survey.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool behind a dry-stone wall with the sea beyond
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other pool-and-sea frame with the same disqualifiers, confirmed on a crop: a utility pole and cables crossing the sea horizon, a red car and other vehicles parked on the road behind the wall, an orange life ring on the stonework, hard midday light and a very large empty sky.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a bath, a basin and an open door to a bedroom
frames.reason: Wide-angle real-estate framing: the basin looms into the bottom-right corner and distorts, the open door edge splits the frame down the middle, and a yellow plastic soap dish holding a used sponge and cloth is cut off at the bottom-left. Flat fill light with no modelling on the marble. Real, but a snapshot.

frames.subject: Dressed dinner tables and folding chairs under string lights at sunset
frames.reason: Warm low sun, dressed tables and festoon lighting sell the wedding story, so it is real and usable. Not hero: the sky is blown to featureless white across the top of the frame, a wooden shed sits mid-ground, guests in swimwear intrude at the right edge, and the composition is a busy sweep rather than a single strong idea.

frames.subject: Hands pouring massage oil from a glass bottle over a client's back, frangipani flower beside
frames.reason: Generic spa product photography — shallow depth of field, anonymous brown backdrop, a tropical frangipani bloom that belongs to no Crete garden, and nothing of the property in frame. Exactly the register the owner's stock rule excludes.
frames.flagReason: Indistinguishable from commercial spa stock imagery; no property context whatsoever and a tropical flower inconsistent with the estate.

frames.subject: Thatched straw umbrellas and white loungers on a pebble beach above turquoise sea
frames.reason: The private beach and gorgeous water colour make this genuinely usable, but it is hard midday light with an empty blue sky, the nearest umbrella canopy crowds the whole top-left of the frame, and loungers are sliced by three edges. Good support, not the clean-horizon golden-hour frame the A examples describe.

frames.subject: Rectangular pool at dusk holding palm reflections, guests gathered at a wedding arch beyond
frames.reason: Handsome symmetry and still-water palm reflections, but this is event documentation: guests, a draped trestle table, a gazebo, and lighting stands with a tripod at the right edge. The sky is pale and washed. Real and usable, not a full-bleed hero.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate beside an open gate with a key lockbox mounted below it
frames.reason: Two thirds of the frame is blown-out white nothing and the only readable content is signage plus a combination key safe on the wall. Out of focus, no subject, operational detail rather than imagery.

frames.subject: White villa at dusk under a deep blue sky, warm light spilling from an open living space behind a sculptural tree
frames.reason: Blue-hour gradient against warm interior glow, a single strong silhouette holding the left of the frame, clean white planes and generous empty sky for type. Controlled, expensive-looking and unmistakably architectural — hero-grade, full-bleed capable.
