frames.subject: Lawn and a timber boardwalk running to a flat blue sea, wooden outdoor shower cropped at the right edge
frames.reason: Composition falls apart: a dark timber shower structure sliced by the right edge against an otherwise empty half-frame of sea, green plastic mesh windbreak visible behind the reeds, and flat harsh midday light on a featureless horizon.

frames.subject: Chalkboard cocktail list beside an ice bucket of beer bottles on a wooden bar counter
frames.reason: Bar and catering clutter — a PA speaker on a stand with its cable running down behind, plastic drinking straws, mixed bottles and a paper napkin at the edge. Snapshot depth of field with no property context. The opposite of the register wanted.

frames.subject: Private pool and lawn beside a white villa, stone boundary wall and sea horizon beyond
frames.reason: Clean, bright and genuinely saleable as a listing frame — turquoise water, white architecture, sea beyond. Held back to support by hard midday light with no shadow modelling, a lounger cut off in the foreground, an orange lifebuoy and a green cushion breaking the palette, and overhead wires crossing the sky above the wall.

frames.subject: Pool terrace with white furniture and lawn, the sea beyond
frames.reason: Real and usable: clean white render, dry-stone wall, green lawn, turquoise pool and open sea, and the wire in the distance is a hairline behind the treeline rather than a graphic element across the frame. Kept off hero by hard midday light, an orange life ring on the wall, a leaning stake in the bed, patio chairs sliced by both the right and bottom edges and a broad empty run of paving through the middle.

frames.subject: Lit estate entrance driveway at dusk with an illuminated logo wall and villas behind
frames.reason: Lovely blue-hour sky with an orange band at the horizon and nicely controlled ground lighting. But the subject is a branded signage wall and a large empty paved apron — arrival documentation rather than an aspirational hero. Strong support frame.

frames.subject: Turquoise private pool beside a white villa, sun lounger and stone wall in the foreground
frames.reason: Same terrace again in a taller crop: bright and clean, but harsh overhead light, a lounger and a green cushion sliced by the bottom-left corner, an orange lifebuoy against the stone, and utility wires strung across the sky above the boundary wall. Usable support only.

frames.subject: Double bedroom with rolled towels on a white bed, glazed door to a terrace
frames.reason: Wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits high on the wall directly above the bed, with a ceiling fan and light cutting the top edge — the exact defect the standard rejects. Flat frontal light and a wide-angle snapshot geometry compound it.

frames.subject: Illuminated estate entrance and logo wall at dusk against a blue and orange sky
frames.reason: The better-exposed version of the entrance: rich blue-hour gradient, warm sunset band, tidy ground lighting. Still a signage frame with a big empty driveway through the foreground, so it works as arrival support rather than a full-bleed hero.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and dining table with flowers in a face-shaped vase, staircase beyond
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit prominent at the top left with a small wall speaker beside it, plus a coloured knife block, appliance faces and a cluttered mid-ground of doorway and stairs. Flat interior light and no single subject.

frames.subject: Beach direction signboard on a post above a gravel track running to the sea
frames.reason: Utility signage as the subject, green plastic mesh fencing running down the right side and again across the background, bare scrub and stony waste ground, and blank hard midday sky. Nothing here reads as luxury.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a robe on the bed and a balcony door opening to the sea
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit is the first thing the eye hits in the top-right corner, with exposed wall conduit, sockets and a switch plate scattered across the left wall. Sea view is reduced to a small doorway slot and the bed is cropped by the bottom edge.

frames.subject: Blue pool vacuum head and hose being drawn across the floor of a swimming pool
frames.reason: Maintenance equipment as the subject — the pool cleaner and its hose fill the frame with no architecture, horizon or context of any kind. Pretty water caustics cannot rescue a service photograph.
frames.flagReason: Tight crop of pool water and cleaning gear with zero property context; indistinguishable from generic pool-maintenance stock, so it cannot be verified as this estate.

frames.subject: Paved path curving between villas towards the sea, with newly planted beds either side
frames.reason: Reads as a developer handover record: bare earth beds with black drip-irrigation line snaking across them, sapling plants, a raw timber box dumped in the bottom-right corner, buildings cropped at both edges and a wire crossing the sky at the left. Harsh midday light throughout.

frames.subject: Pool at dusk mirroring palm trees, guests standing by a white ceremony arch
frames.reason: The same handsome dusk reflection in a wider crop, and the extra width brings in more clutter — a camera bag on the paving, lighting stands, towels and bags heaped on the loungers, a gazebo. Event documentation: real and usable, not hero.

frames.subject: Bedroom with folded robes on a white bed beneath a triptych of goldfish prints
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit centred high on the wall directly above the headboard, which is the standard's named reject. Otherwise flat frontal light, a large blank white wall through the middle and a cluttered pillow arrangement.

frames.subject: Row of thatched umbrellas and loungers on a pebble beach above clear turquoise water
frames.reason: Same beach frame as earlier in the set and graded the same: real private-beach content with beautiful water colour, undermined by flat midday light, an empty blue sky and the nearest canopy swallowing the top-left corner with loungers cut at the edges.

frames.subject: Whitewashed archway framing a path down to the sea, people walking through
frames.reason: Good idea, poor frame: the sky is blown to flat white across the whole upper half, a parked van intrudes at the left edge, and the bottom third is stained, paint-marked concrete forecourt. Hazy low-contrast light with no colour anywhere.

frames.subject: Estate signboard for private sunbeds screwed to a wooden post against a clear sky
frames.reason: A sign on a pole and nothing else — the left half of the frame is empty blue. Signage detail with no property, no light and no composition.

frames.subject: White archway gateway to the beach path with a wall-mounted estate sign
frames.reason: Wider crop of the same gateway and no better: featureless white sky, the same white van at the left edge, and a large stained concrete apron filling the foreground. Flat hazy light throughout.

frames.subject: Small turquoise pool beside a white villa wall, umbrella and blue loungers against a stone wall
frames.reason: Clean architecture, good water colour and a sea glimpse make it usable. But a blank white wall takes the whole left third, a blue bag is left on the step, a beige utility box is mounted on the stone wall and an orange lifebuoy sits at the right edge, all under hard midday sun.

frames.subject: Outdoor dining table set with red wine and glasses beside a pool and timber screen
frames.reason: Nicely staged with wine, glasses and a plate of food, and the pool and sun bed give it depth — real and usable. Not hero: the top half is empty blue sky, a laminated pool-rules notice is pinned to the fence behind, and the outdoor kitchen and shower post clutter the mid-ground under flat noon light.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a corner whirlpool bath, wall-hung toilet and vanity basin
frames.reason: Toilet sits centre frame with an exposed bidet spray hose and pipework beside it, plus a floor drain in the foreground tiles. Plumbing fixtures as subject, flat wide-angle real-estate framing, and a novelty ornament competing at each end.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub in the foreground of a terrace with a dining table and sun bed beyond
frames.reason: Real amenity content with the terrace legible behind it, so it earns support use. Weak as a hero: the acrylic tub shell is cropped by three edges and fills the lower half, a blank white wall takes the right side, a laminated safety notice hangs on the fence and the light is flat midday.

frames.subject: Breakfast table crowded with bread, cured meats, cheese, eggs, juice and jam jars
frames.reason: Cluttered and unstyled — plastic condiment sachets, a branded honey jar, a coffee capsule and a cardboard carton sit among the plates, the foreground is a blur of jam jars and the background is blown out. Snapshot depth of field with no room or view to place it.
frames.flagReason: No property context at all and several third-party branded packets and a coffee capsule in frame; cannot be confirmed as in-villa photography.

frames.subject: Bowl of sesame-dusted fried pastries on a table beside disposable cups and cutlery
frames.reason: Low-quality snapshot: harsh flat on-camera light, muddy colour, plastic cups and foil trays around the edges and a bare vinyl tablecloth. Catering-table documentation, the exact register the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: Reads as a catering or cookery-demonstration table with disposable serviceware and no property signature; worth confirming it was shot on the estate at all.

frames.subject: Staff carrying a platter of stuffed mushrooms and a bowl of pasta salad at a draped buffet table
frames.reason: Catering service documentation — cropped torsos, serving tongs and a chafing stand fill the frame, with no property visible; exactly the buffet register the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Guests on floor cushions under pop-up canopies on a stony beach at golden hour
frames.reason: Warm low sun, but a graffiti-tagged wall sits at the left edge, dry stony ground fills the whole foreground, and hired gazebos, marquees and distant utility poles clutter the mid-ground; snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Orange juice and fruit on a small round table beside a white chair on a sunlit terrace
frames.reason: Clean, warmly styled detail with real terrace context — glass balustrade, lawn behind — but hard contrast, a flat green backdrop and a minor subject; good support, not full-bleed material.

frames.subject: The Thalasses wordmark, white script beside a circular sun-and-sea logo on black
frames.reason: A brand logo asset rather than a photograph; carries no light, composition or property imagery and cannot serve as editorial content.

frames.subject: Open timber gate in a white wall framing a pool and palms under clear blue sky
frames.reason: Deliberate symmetrical framing and a clean deep-blue sky, but the bottom third is bare scuffed concrete and weeds, a festoon cable and poles cross the sky, and bystanders crowd the bar at left; usable, not hero.

frames.subject: Bamboo-shaded side passage beside a lawn and uplit stone wall at dusk
frames.reason: Pretty pink dusk light, but a louvred air-conditioning grille sits in the top-left corner (confirmed on a crop), with a downpipe and a door handle crowding the blank white wall at left; AC and utility clutter.

frames.subject: Guests dancing on a concrete poolside terrace at dusk
frames.reason: Event documentation: blown-out white sky, cocktail tables cropped at both frame edges, a wide empty concrete apron and backs of heads; flat light and snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Wooden desk and chair on a parquet floor by a window, shot at a steep tilt
frames.reason: Severely tilted framing with bare floorboards filling most of the frame and the desk cut off at the top; the angle reads as an accident, not a choice.

frames.subject: Private pool between a white villa wall and a stone-and-timber boundary wall under deep blue sky
frames.reason: Turquoise water, clean stonework and a strong perspective line, but flat hard midday light, a white downpipe on the right edge and towels left on the step; a solid support frame rather than a hero.

frames.subject: Crate of tomatoes, courgettes and aubergines at the edge of a vegetable plot under blue sky
frames.reason: Reads as a working farm rather than a luxury villa — bare dusty soil across the frame, the crate cropped hard into the bottom corner, and oversaturated colour.

frames.subject: White villa nameplate on an exterior wall with a blurred terrace behind
frames.reason: Shallow snapshot detail with no scene: a black cable and a padlocked meter box sit in the lower corner and the whole background is defocused mush.

frames.subject: Kitchen counter with coloured-handled knives, plastic nesting bowls and a steel sink
frames.reason: Cheap plastic kitchenware and a socket strip on a tilted axis; a cluttered utility close-up, the opposite of the expensive register.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a sandy beach above turquoise water
frames.reason: Full-bleed hero: dead-straight horizon, a superb turquoise-to-deep-blue water gradient over pale sand, thatched umbrellas and a timber boardwalk that read as an expensive private beach, and a clean upper sky that leaves room for a headline. Hard midday light puts black shadows under the umbrellas and the dune bank in the bottom-left corner is scruffy, but neither breaks the frame and the composition is the strongest here.

frames.subject: Long empty sand beach curving along a rocky bay with mountains behind
frames.reason: Handsome wide coastal landscape but hazy, oversaturated and soft, and it shows open coastline rather than the villa grounds; usable only as destination content.
frames.flagReason: A wide public bay and headland with mountains — an open stretch of coast, not the estate's private beach.

frames.subject: Navy helicopter parked on a concrete pad with a Thalasses watermark across the frame
frames.reason: A watermark is stamped over the middle of the image, power lines run across the sky, and the setting is weeds, a shed and a bare concrete apron; phone-snapshot quality.
frames.flagReason: The frame carries a Thalasses watermark burned into the image, and the location is an off-site landing pad rather than the estate grounds.

frames.subject: Bedroom with robes laid on the bed and a glass door opening onto a pool and the sea
frames.reason: Real and usable — pool and blue sea visible through the door, clean wood and white — but the bed is crowded with staged gifts and glassware and the light is flat; catalogue-grade support.

frames.subject: Twin beds pushed together and dressed with robes and towels under a wooden headboard
frames.reason: Bright, tidy interior with a warm palette and considered props, but staging clutter is spread across the whole bed and a kitchen doorway with a fridge intrudes at the right edge.

frames.subject: Pool and timber deck beside a villa terrace with an orange life ring on the wall
frames.reason: Clean turquoise water and deep blue sky, but a lounger is cut off at the bottom corner, the orange life ring pulls the eye off-centre, and satellite dishes and a utility pole show over the fence.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a candle and orchid on the bed and glass doors onto a terrace
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit is clipped into the top edge of the frame (confirmed on a crop), and the bed is cut off at the right; the named AC defect in an otherwise ordinary interior.

frames.subject: Loungers with blue towels in front of a timber-clad hot tub and flowering bougainvillea
frames.reason: An umbrella pole runs straight down the centre of the frame, the hot tub is cropped top and bottom, and the loungers are sliced by both edges; snapshot framing of a good subject.

frames.subject: Lit pool at dusk with a party gathering under festoon lights
frames.reason: Event documentation: pop-up gazebos, trestle tables, a scatter of guests and a utility pole at the left, all under a dull grey sky with no colour in it, and the bottom two-thirds of the frame is an undifferentiated slab of lit blue water. Catering set-up is the opposite of the register wanted.

frames.subject: Chrome bath mixer tap and shower hose against white tiling
frames.reason: Tilted utility close-up with water spotting visible on the tile and a tap manufacturer's logo as the sharpest element; no property context at all.
frames.flagReason: Tight branded plumbing-fixture close-up carrying another company's logo and no property context — indistinguishable from generic product imagery.

frames.subject: Old ochre-rendered stone mansion behind a barbed-wire fence under deep blue sky
frames.reason: A rusty post and strands of barbed wire cut across the whole foreground, and the render is patched and stained; a documentary heritage record, not property imagery.
frames.flagReason: A historic ochre-rendered mansion or monastery building in open countryside — nothing to do with the estate's white contemporary architecture.

frames.subject: Hot tub set in grass, deck loungers and a colour-lit pool at blue hour
frames.reason: Attractive dusk light with lit stonework and coloured pool LEDs, but a portrait crop with the top third empty sky, an orange life ring on the wall, and neighbouring rooftops and a pole visible over the fence.

frames.subject: Guests dressed in white around a poolside with palms and the sea behind at low sun
frames.reason: Soft backlight through the palms and an airy pale palette make this the most stylish of the event frames, but the sky is blown out, a cable crosses it, and a crowd occupies the mid-ground; coverage, not hero.

frames.subject: Crowded breakfast table with cheese, cold cuts, sausages, jam and coffee
frames.reason: Clutter fills the frame — condiment sachets, a cardboard packet and a coffee capsule sit in the foreground, with plates cropped on every edge and no clean subject.

frames.subject: Miniature ouzo bottles piled in a woven basket
frames.reason: A branded beverage close-up with no property context; the third-party labels are the subject and the composition is a tight snapshot.
frames.flagReason: Third-party drinks branding fills the frame with nothing of the estate visible; matches the earlier branded-beverage frames that were held for review.

frames.subject: Aerial view of a lit pool terrace set with round dinner tables beside the sea at dusk
frames.reason: Real and atmospheric with the sea horizon behind, but it is event documentation — banquet tables, a milling crowd, parked cars at the right and a flat grey sky.

frames.subject: Guests seated on cushions at low tables watching the sun set over the sea
frames.reason: Genuine golden-hour warmth, a sun path on the water and distant headlands, but it is people-led and shot from behind, with a wide band of dusty gravel across the foreground.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool between a white villa wall and a dry-stone wall
frames.reason: A crop confirms a utility pole with a cross-arm and a power cable running across the upper-left sky, with a neighbour's roof and a beige apartment block sitting above the wall behind. Hard midday sun blows the highlights on the white render and the outdoor kitchen unit sits awkwardly mid-frame. Strong colour, but poles and cables are the named reject.

frames.subject: Close-up of the badge on a cream retro refrigerator in a kitchen
frames.reason: A branded appliance logo is the entire subject, with the rest of the kitchen thrown out of focus; no property context and no scene.
frames.flagReason: The frame is dominated by another company's appliance branding with no identifiable property context.

frames.subject: Crate of vegetables in a vegetable plot with the sea visible beyond a white wall
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other garden frame and no stronger — bare dusty soil across two thirds of the picture, the crate cropped into the bottom corner, farm rather than villa register.

frames.subject: Uplit garden path between villa buildings leading to a sunset sea view
frames.reason: Blue-hour sky grading from deep blue to sunset orange, warm uplights on stone and timber, in-ground path lights, and a symmetrical paved path that pulls the eye straight through the gap between the buildings to the horizon. Controlled light, expensive-looking and full-bleed capable — the same register as the curator's A dusk architecture frames. A crop shows bare-soil beds with black drip hose in the lower corners and a hairline mast wire at upper left; both are peripheral and neither reads at page size.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a petal-strewn tub and a sea-view window
frames.reason: Genuinely nice material and daylight through the window onto the sea, but the composition is crowded: basin and mirror shelf cut by the left edge, tub and shower hose cut by the right, and the eye has no single subject. Good support, not a hero frame.

frames.subject: Aerial view of a poolside dinner at dusk, with round banquet tables, guests, palms and the sea behind
frames.reason: The curator's own worked example grades 'Pool event at dusk, aerial — busy with people and equipment; event documentation' as B, and this is that frame. Real, warm, unmistakably the seafront terrace. Held off anything higher by the washed-out white sky, the parked cars on the coast road at the right edge (confirmed at 2.5x: a red car, a white van and a dark saloon), a PA speaker on a stand, the thatched bar hut and scattered cocktail tables. Support, not hero.

frames.subject: Buffet chafing dishes on a dressed table at an outdoor event
frames.reason: Stainless chafing dishes and catering trays fill the foreground — exactly the catering-gear register the standard rejects. Utility poles and overhead wires cut the background sky, and a PA speaker on a stand sits centre frame.

frames.subject: White cubic villa with turquoise pool and lawn under midday sun
frames.reason: Handsome architecture wrecked by frame edges: a streetlamp head intrudes into the top-left corner, utility poles and wires run behind the fence at left, a parked car shows at the right edge, and blue sling loungers plus a wooden picnic table clutter the lawn. Hard midday light with no modelling.

frames.subject: Bucket of iced Mythos beer bottles on a white surface
frames.reason: A branded beverage product shot with shallow depth of field and no property context at all — another company's logo is the subject of the frame. Reads as commercial stock beverage photography.
frames.flagReason: Generic branded beer product shot carrying Mythos branding rather than anything of the estate; indistinguishable from stock beverage imagery.

frames.subject: Private pool lit green at dusk above the sea, sunset horizon
frames.reason: The strongest frame in the batch: controlled dusk light, a clean sea horizon with a full sunset gradient, warm-lit stone wall, teak deck and the pool glowing green-blue. Expensive-looking and full-bleed capable; the small white service panel on the wall is retouchable and does not carry the frame.

frames.subject: Thalasses logo and lettering on a white wall against blue sky
frames.reason: Clean, well-lit graphic detail with hard shadow raking across the white render — useful brand/arrival imagery and it confirms the estate. But a signage detail cannot carry a full-bleed hero; there is no place, light or space in it.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a sandy beach above turquoise sea
frames.reason: Real private-beach content with genuinely beautiful water colour, but shot at hard midday rather than the golden hour the A beach frames have, roughly two-thirds of the vertical frame is empty sky, and a yellow timber ramp cuts awkwardly into the bottom-left corner. Strong support, not hero.

frames.subject: White villa with open glazed living room beside a turquoise pool
frames.reason: Clean modern architecture, good pool colour and the interior visible through the folded glass doors. Held back by flat overhead midday light, overhead cables crossing the upper-right sky, and a busy background of fence, chairs and neighbouring roofs. Usable, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Personal trainer coaching a woman with a barbell in a gym
frames.reason: An indoor commercial gym with a car park visible through the glazing and a slogan T-shirt as the subject — nothing of the property in frame. Generic fitness stock of exactly the kind the standard excludes.
frames.flagReason: Generic gym/fitness stock photograph with a car park behind the glass; no connection to the estate.

frames.subject: Wooden swing frame, slide and trampoline on green rubber matting
frames.reason: Reads as a family park or holiday-camp play area, not a luxury villa estate: green rubber safety tiles, a plastic slide, a netted trampoline, plus dining tables and a parked car in the background. Hard midday light and a cluttered, cut-off foreground climbing frame.

frames.subject: Whitewashed entrance arch with palms under a blown-out sky
frames.reason: Completely flat, blown-out white sky with no tone in it, and the bottom third is empty grey asphalt road. A vehicle and a utility pole show behind the wall at left. Snapshot framing of an arrival gate rather than an image.

frames.subject: Coloured recycling bins beside a garden path at sunset
frames.reason: The sunset behind the villas is lovely, but blue, yellow and green recycling bins sit in the near left foreground and pull the eye straight to them — service clutter as the front subject. A wall light also flares badly at the left edge.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and dining area with a timber table and sliding doors onto a sea view
frames.reason: A wall-mounted split air-conditioning unit sits high on the main wall in the centre of frame — the first item on the reject list, and the curator rejected a hot tub frame for exactly this. Compounded by a blown ceiling fitting anchoring the top, a dining chair sliced by the right edge, a kettle and coffee machine on the worktop, and a dead band of empty ceiling across the top third.

frames.subject: White paved path curving through planted gardens between villa blocks
frames.reason: Tidy, well-kept grounds with good planting and a glimpse of sea at the end of the path. But it is flat midday light, the upper half is empty blue sky, and there is no focal point — pleasant grounds coverage, not a hero.

frames.subject: White kitchen and dining space with a timber table, teal sofa and the sea through sliding glass doors
frames.reason: The better crop of the two, with clean white balance and the turquoise sea reading through the glazing — but the split AC unit is confirmed at 2.5x as the darkest, most legible object in the upper half of the frame, with a black sensor on the right wall beside it. Kettle, coffee machine, bowls and a dishwasher fascia line the counter. AC plus appliance clutter is the named reject register regardless of how pleasant the room is.

frames.subject: Guests dressed in white at a night party under string lights
frames.reason: Flash-lit event documentation against a black sky: white plastic folding chairs stacked into the left foreground, a bare concrete terrace, a utility pole at right and cabling overhead. Party record, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Roof terrace with chair, juice and a view over fields to mountains
frames.reason: The whole outlook is crossed by utility poles and power lines — several strung right through the mountain view — and the middle distance is village rooftops and a concrete outbuilding. The terrace itself is a large empty white slab with the photographer's shadow at bottom right.

frames.subject: Catering staff arranging salad bowls at a buffet table
frames.reason: Staff-and-catering documentary under a completely flat, blown-out sky: a POS terminal, serving tongs, a PA speaker and cocktail tables all in frame. Catering gear and flat light.

frames.subject: Helicopter parked on a dusty apron, with a logo watermark across the frame
frames.reason: A large semi-transparent logo watermark is laid across the middle of the image, the setting is a bare dirt-and-gravel apron with scrub, and a power line crosses the sky at left. Nothing of the estate is visible and the watermark alone rules it out for use.
frames.flagReason: Carries a large watermark burned across the centre of the frame; also shows no property context, so it cannot be confirmed as the estate's own imagery.

frames.subject: Outdoor kitchen counter and folding chairs beside a small pool
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: the sink counter eats the right half, two blue mesh folding chairs are cut by the bottom-left edge, and a black cable runs down the wall beside the light. Cheap folding furniture and harsh midday contrast.

frames.subject: Villa blocks and paved drive seen across the estate grounds
frames.reason: Power lines and a utility pole cross the sky at top left, a drab olive-rendered service structure blocks the whole left foreground, and the lower half is empty grey paving with bare soil beds behind. Flat midday light on a construction-record composition.

frames.subject: Orange juice and a magazine on a wooden side table by a glass rail
frames.reason: Warm directional sun and a genuine styled detail with the green field behind, which gives it some editorial feel. But the glass balustrade throws confusing double reflections across the left half and the props are small and scattered. Support detail only.

frames.subject: Gardener working among young shrubs in a bare planting field
frames.reason: Documentary of bare earth, young oleanders and exposed drip lines; a road with parked cars and a white wall run across the middle, a cable crosses the sky, and stray paper litters the ground. Reads as a nursery or farm plot, not a villa estate.

frames.subject: Bowl of milky porridge with a spoon on a white plate
frames.reason: Murky, under-lit close-up with the food out of focus at the front, a chipped decorated plate and an undefined dark background. Poor food photography with nothing of the property in it.
frames.flagReason: A tight food close-up with no property context at all; cannot be confirmed as shot at the estate.

frames.subject: Timber outdoor shower beside a grass lawn above the open sea
frames.reason: Beautiful sea colour, but the framing is a snapshot: the timber shower structure is cut off at the right edge, green plastic mesh sheeting shows behind it, the horizon sits dead centre, and the foreground is patchy weedy grass with no subject.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub with a champagne bucket and towels on decking
frames.reason: The styling is undone by the hardware: manufacturer warning and instruction labels are clearly stuck to the tub shell and the cabinet, with a black vent grille beside them. Harsh midday light, the top half is empty pale sky, and the outlook behind is fencing and distant buildings.

frames.subject: Scuba divers descending over a sandy underwater slope
frames.reason: An underwater diving frame with no property in it at all — the same generic activity-illustration register as the stock cyclist frames the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: Generic scuba-diving stock imagery used to illustrate an activity; nothing of the estate is visible and it cannot be attributed to this property.

frames.subject: Roof terrace seating with a view over fields and power lines
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other terrace frame and no stronger: utility poles and multiple power lines cross the entire view, village rooftops and a concrete shed fill the middle distance, and a shadow intrudes into the bottom-right corner of the empty white terrace.

frames.subject: Double bed with wooden headboard, robes and butterfly wall art
frames.reason: Clean, tidy and well-presented, and the symmetry is deliberate. But the light is flat and frontal, there is no window or view, and the decor styling reads as a mid-range hotel room. Real and usable, not hero.

frames.subject: Pool at dusk with palms reflected in still water and guests by the sea wall
frames.reason: The mirror reflection of the palms in the still pool is the best thing in the frame and nearly carries it, but the sky is washed out to near-white and the edges are full of event kit — bags and towels dumped on the loungers at left, a light stand, cases and folding chairs at right. Event documentation with a good composition.

frames.subject: Beach sign on a post beside a gravel track running down to the sea
frames.reason: Documentary signage frame: chain-link and green mesh fencing running down both sides, dry weeds and bare dirt, harsh midday light and a blown white sign face. Snapshot framing with the sign cropped hard against the top-left corner.

frames.subject: Large lit pool at night with festoon lights, a moon and guests gathered beyond
frames.reason: Genuinely atmospheric — deep blue water, string lights and the moon — but it is event documentation: a crowd of guests, umbrellas, a bar table and a cabana crowd the far edge, and the near half is a large empty sheet of water. Real and usable, not clean enough for full bleed.

frames.subject: A man in a black t-shirt drawing the cork from a wine bottle at a wooden counter
frames.reason: Head cropped off above the frame, and two grey waste bins sit in plain view behind his left arm. No property context at all — a generic hands-and-bottle frame that could have been shot anywhere.
frames.flagReason: Nothing in frame identifies the estate: a cropped figure, a plain wooden counter and bins. Cannot confirm it was shot on the property.

frames.subject: Open-plan living room with a grey sofa, round dining table and a compact kitchen
frames.reason: Clean, bright and tidy, and the beech dining chairs match those in other rooms in this set. But it is flat real-estate coverage: a blown-out ceiling fitting, a black subwoofer box on the floor, trinket clutter on the console and no view or light doing any work. Support only.

frames.subject: A wooden desk and chair on a parquet floor, shot at a steep tilt
frames.reason: The frame is rotated almost ninety degrees so the floor reads as a wall — disorienting rather than stylish. Empty subject, blown window light spilling across the boards, and nothing that identifies the space.

frames.subject: Pool at dusk with a palm reflected in the water and the sea beyond
frames.reason: Handsome twilight colour and a strong palm reflection, but the deck is untidied: towels draped over the loungers, a holdall and bags on the ground, and a dark canopy blocking the right side. The magenta LED wash also cheapens what the sunset is already doing.

frames.subject: Terrace table and chair with juice, overlooking a lawn, white villa roofs and the sea
frames.reason: At 2x the left third resolves a utility pole with a crossarm and cables fanning out across the sky right on the sea horizon, and the neighbouring plot below it is bare earth and rubble behind a black railing. On top of the cables the composition fails: a blank white column bisects the frame down the middle and hard midday light leaves the upper two thirds an empty blue field.

frames.subject: Couple at a low table dressed with lanterns on the rocks at sunset, sea behind
frames.reason: Hero-grade: golden low sun on a glass-calm sea, headland silhouettes, lanterns and floor cushions arranged into a simple symmetrical block. Cinematic, warm and expensive-looking — it sells the private-dining story in one frame.

frames.subject: Branded toiletry bottle tucked into a folded white towel on a bed
frames.reason: Almost the whole frame is out of focus; the only sharp element is a third-party cosmetics label. Reads as generic amenity product photography with no property context.
frames.flagReason: Tight close-up carrying another company's brand label and no visible property context — confirm it is the estate's own photography before use.

frames.subject: Pool at dusk with palms mirrored in still water and guests by a white arch
frames.reason: The mirror-flat reflection of the palms is lovely, but this is event documentation: a wedding arch, catering tables, a lighting stand and a camera bag on the deck at right, and towels heaped on the loungers at left. Usable support.

frames.subject: Twin bedroom in white and pale wood with a glazed door onto a terrace
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits high on the left wall, exactly the defect the standard rejects. Beyond that the framing is ordinary listing coverage with a cupboard edge and a vase of pink flowers crowding the right edge.

frames.subject: White two-storey villa at dusk with a green-lit pool and a hot tub on decking
frames.reason: Good blue-hour light and clean cubic architecture, but the frame is spread thin: a large empty lawn foreground, a roller-shutter box on the wall, a hot tub and steps filling the right third, and an orange life ring that pulls the eye off the building.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and white loungers on a pebble shore above turquoise water
frames.reason: Unmistakably the private shoreline and the water colour is excellent, but the light is hard midday rather than the low sun the A-grade beach frames have, and the foreground is cluttered by a near umbrella post and a cropped wooden bench cutting the bottom-left corner.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool and stone wall with a parasol, loungers and a barrel hot tub above the sea
frames.reason: Genuinely handsome stonework, clean turquoise water and a dressed hot tub terrace with the sea beyond — real and usable. Not full bleed: hard flat midday light, more than half the frame given to empty sky, a thin overhead wire crossing at horizon level near the parasol, a distant apartment block at the right, and an orange life ring as the most saturated thing in the picture. The wire is a single thin line rather than a pole silhouette and the life ring sits in a croppable corner, which keeps it off the reject pile.

frames.subject: Overhead aerial of paved garden paths with a small group of people standing on them
frames.reason: Straight-down drone documentation with no subject — the people are anonymous specks, the planting beds show bare dry soil and patchy grass, and the dominant shapes are concrete paving. Reads as a site record, not editorial.

frames.subject: Terrace bench with spotted cushions behind a glass balustrade, village and hills beyond
frames.reason: A power pylon and slack overhead cables run right through the view on the right, with a street light beside them. The left half is a blank white parapet, so the frame is half dead wall and half utility lines.

frames.subject: Paved garden path between white buildings leading toward the sea
frames.reason: Clean landscaping and a good leading line down to the water, but the light is flat harsh midday, the top half is an empty blue sky, and slatted timber fencing dominates both sides. Solid support imagery.

frames.subject: View from inside a room through open glass doors to a private pool and the sea
frames.reason: Nicely layered — pool, stone wall, blue sea band — but a utility pole and wires stand on the horizon above the wall, the dining table is sliced off along the bottom edge, and the right third is blank wall with cushions. Good support.

frames.subject: Sun lounger with a blue towel and a striped cushion beside a pool, shot at an angle
frames.reason: Crooked snapshot framing with the lounger cut by the top and left edges, most of the frame soft, and an orange life ring blurred into the corner. Detail shot with no composition holding it together.

frames.subject: Lit villa veranda at dusk above a green-lit pool with a pool ladder in the foreground
frames.reason: A utility pole and overhead cables stand against the sky at the left edge with a parked car beneath them, a red life ring hangs centre-left, and the green LED wash floods the walls an unnatural colour. The chrome ladder cuts across the foreground.

frames.subject: Crate of vegetables at the edge of a vegetable plot under a deep blue sky
frames.reason: The crate is chopped off by the bottom-left corner, the ground is dry bare soil with irrigation pipe, and the light is flat hard midday. Reads as a farm record, not villa imagery.

frames.subject: Bathroom with a bath on one side and a washbasin on the other, window between
frames.reason: A blank white wall runs straight down the centre and splits the frame in two, and the one thing visible through the window is a bundle of overhead power cables. Awkward composition with utility lines in the only view.

frames.subject: Pool terrace with a white parasol, loungers and a stone wall open to the sea
frames.reason: Layered and appealing, with the sea band and lawn reading well, but the foreground is jammed with a table and two chairs cropped by the bottom edge, an orange life ring hangs on the fence, and the light is hard midday. Usable support.

frames.subject: Rolled blue towel and an anchor-print bolster cushion on a lounger
frames.reason: Tilted, very tight crop of bedding with the lounger cut on every side and the background reduced to blurred decking and grass. Snapshot detail, no property context.

frames.subject: Woman in a slip dress leading a small child by the hand across a terrace at night
frames.reason: A real, warm moment and the reed fencing and olive tree place it on the grounds, but it is people-led with both subjects turned away, a street light flaring in the background, and a tall vertical crop that will not run full bleed.

frames.subject: Small private pool with a parasol and two loungers behind a stone and timber wall
frames.reason: Competent and clean, but the frame is dominated by slatted timber fencing and a rolled bamboo awning, a black bench is cropped by the right edge, and the top third is empty sky under flat midday sun. Support only.

frames.subject: Rolled bathrobe, slippers and a white rose laid out on a made bed
frames.reason: Checked the foreground at 1.8x — the rolled robe and slipper hold real terry texture, so this is a deliberate shallow-focus turndown detail, not a missed frame. Soft warm light and it reads as care. Support only: the highlights on the bedding are close to clipped, the lamp and headboard are cropped awkwardly, the red-striped cushion clashes with the navy one in the pillow line, and the lower right is dead white space.

frames.subject: White villa lit at twilight above a glowing turquoise pool
frames.reason: The best twilight light in the batch, and it still fails. At 2.2x the left third carries a concrete utility pole with crossarms and several sagging cables silhouetted against the pink sky, and the right side has two more cables strung across between a pole and the neighbouring building. Blue metal sling chairs are cut off at the bottom-left edge. Utility poles, cables and cheap furniture are three separate named defects, all legible at full size and none of them croppable.

frames.subject: Long sandy beach lined with netted shade structures, daybeds and rows of blue umbrellas
frames.reason: Warm low light and a clean sea horizon, but it is a mass of commercial beach furniture receding to the vanishing point, with trampled sand filling the foreground. Handsome, and only support-grade.
frames.flagReason: A wide sandy beach organised with rows of daybeds and blue umbrellas stretching into the distance — a beach-club or public strand, not the small pebble-and-rock private shoreline seen elsewhere in this set.

frames.subject: White villa with a turquoise pool, sun loungers and a parasol at midday
frames.reason: A concrete power pole with overhead cables sits against the sky on the left and more wires run in from the right, blue metal folding chairs are cropped into the left edge, and an orange life ring hangs on the wall. Flat harsh light throughout.

frames.subject: Corner of a made bed against a timber-panelled headboard wall with a pendant lamp
frames.reason: A power socket and switch plate sit almost dead centre against the panelling, and half the frame is blank wood. The bed is sliced off along the bottom and left, so the eye lands on the electrics.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining area opening through folding glass doors onto a sunlit terrace
frames.reason: Bright, tidy and well squared up, with the terrace light doing real work. Held back by a bulky fridge and coffee machine filling the left third, a blown-out doorway, and a large expanse of empty white floor. Good support.

frames.subject: Chrome SMEG lettering on a cream retro fridge door, kitchen blurred behind
frames.reason: A branded appliance logo fills the frame at close range with everything behind thrown out of focus; no property, no light, no story - a product detail, not villa imagery.
frames.flagReason: The whole subject is another company's brand mark (SMEG); reads as generic appliance product photography with no Thalasses signature.

frames.subject: Bartender pouring a drink at an outdoor timber bar in low sun
frames.reason: Warm low sun on the forearms is the only thing working. The subject is decapitated by the crop, a tier of plastic pour-spout syrup bottles with green and yellow caps runs along the lower left, third-party liquor bottles stand across the counter and a black plastic tray intrudes at the right. Service and catering gear is the register the curator explicitly rejects.
frames.flagReason: Third-party spirit and syrup branding is legible on the bottles and caps in the foreground.

frames.subject: White bedroom with wooden headboard and a fruit and sparkling wine tray on the bed
frames.reason: Tidy, well-lit room with a clean line to the terrace door and warm wood accents; but it is flat interior real-estate lighting and the ceiling fan and wall art are cut by the frame edges, so it supports rather than leads.

frames.subject: Gerbera daisies in a white face-shaped vase by a sunlit window
frames.reason: Soft window light, fresh colour and a considered off-centre placement with intentional shallow depth of field — nothing from the reject list is in it. Support only, and no more: the vase is clipped at the bottom edge, the background is a blown jumble of mint chair and doorframe, and there is no property context, so it can only ever be a small decorative tile.

frames.subject: Wooden playground on green turf between white villas with the sea behind
frames.reason: Playground frame on artificial turf reading as a family park, surrounded by bare construction dirt, staked saplings and black irrigation hose across the foreground.

frames.subject: Thatched parasols and sunloungers on a pebble-and-sand shoreline above turquoise sea
frames.reason: Beautiful water colour, a clean horizon and the thatched parasols read well — but this is not the hero the other grader claimed. Both of the curator's A beach frames are golden hour with low sun; this is flat noon that bleaches the sand and kills the shadows. At 2.2x the bottom-left corner is filled with a raw untreated pine staircase, with a yellow slatted ice bucket and a patch of dug-over sand beside it. Strong support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Woman in a silk dress leading a small child across a lit terrace at night
frames.reason: A real, warm evening moment with a nice olive tree and dusk sky, but it is people-led with both subjects turned away, the light is hard flash against a black background, and a lamp post and scattered cushions sit in the mid-ground.

frames.subject: Catering staff setting out salad bowls on a draped buffet table at dusk
frames.reason: Catering gear - mixing bowls, a POS terminal, a trestle table and cabling - under a blank white overcast sky; exactly the event-documentation register the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: Reads as an off-site events or catering venue with staff and equipment rather than any villa space; worth confirming it was shot on the estate.

frames.subject: Shaded terrace of set dining tables under an orange sail, white villas beyond
frames.reason: Bright, clean and it does show the architecture and a sliver of sea, but the composition is busy with chair legs, a green tarpaulin structure at the left edge and coloured recycling bins beyond the lawn; usable support at best.

frames.subject: Empty tiled side path along a white villa wall towards a parasol and lounger
frames.reason: Dead composition - half blank wall, half empty sky - with bare soil and exposed black drip-irrigation tubing running the length of the right-hand bed.

frames.subject: Banquet tables under marquee canopies beside a large pool with guests
frames.reason: Phone-grade snapshot: a beer bottle intrudes into the bottom corner, plastic folding chairs and a speaker stand clutter the frame, and pop-up canopy poles cut the sky.
frames.flagReason: A large communal pool with a goal frame, marquees and crowds reads like an events or hotel venue rather than the private villa pools of this estate.

frames.subject: Young man in a white shirt and sunglasses at a parapet in golden light
frames.reason: A posed guest snapshot with nothing of the property in it beyond a bare white parapet and a hurricane lantern clipped at the edge. At 2.5x the right edge resolves a woman's face and a child's head intruding over the wall, plus a microphone on a stand pointing into frame. Event equipment and bystanders in an identifiable individual's portrait.

frames.subject: Covered veranda with an open kitchen beside a turquoise private pool
frames.reason: Good indoor-outdoor story with a bright pool and a clean kitchen, but harsh midday contrast, a lot of competing furniture and overhead cables visible in the gap above the fence keep it off the hero shortlist.

frames.subject: White bedroom looking through sliding doors to a pool, palms and the sea
frames.reason: Well-styled and calm, with the sea framed by the door and a nice hat-on-bed touch; held back by even, flat interior lighting, a visible cable running down the left wall and a lot of empty white on the right.

frames.subject: Villa at dusk with the pool lit green and a sunset sky behind
frames.reason: Lovely blue-hour gradient, warm interior glow and a green-lit pool - would be hero material, except a utility pole and two power lines cross the sunset sky dead centre, which rules out full bleed as shot.

frames.subject: Open-plan living and kitchen with a sofa, dining table and staircase
frames.reason: Wall-mounted air-conditioning unit prominent in the top corner, plus microwave, kettle, coffee machines and a coloured knife block lined up on the counter - appliance clutter throughout.

frames.subject: Private pool and timber deck beside a white villa, lounger in the foreground
frames.reason: Clean turquoise water and good deck lines, but flat midday light, a bright orange life ring stuck on the wall at eye level and a lounger sliced off by the bottom edge; neighbouring roofs sit on the horizon.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub on a lawn in front of a stone wall and slatted fence
frames.reason: A grey air-conditioning condenser unit is mounted on the wall directly behind the tub, with a folding sling chair and a flue pipe alongside - the exact utility clutter the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Hot tub on a deck under a parasol with the open sea beyond
frames.reason: Real sea view and inviting water, but the parasol and a lounger are both cut hard by the frame edges, the sky is empty harsh midday blue and the champagne-bucket styling reads as brochure filler.

frames.subject: White bedroom with bathrobes and rolled towels on the bed and the sea through balcony doors
frames.reason: Flat, near-blown white-on-white exposure with no tonal separation. At 2.5x the centre wall carries a run of sockets, switches, a small wall fitting and a dangling lead — utility clutter dead centre of the composition. A tall white wardrobe slab fills the left third, robes are dumped across the bed, and the bed cuts the bottom corner in snapshot geometry.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a vessel basin, glass shower and wall-hung toilet
frames.reason: Exposed chrome plumbing and a toilet brush sit centre frame beside the WC, the window is a blown white rectangle, and the shower enclosure is a mass of hardware and reflections.

frames.subject: Twin bedroom with a beige quilt, folded towels and a pool through the door
frames.reason: Tidy and usable as room documentation with a pool glimpse through the door, but the tan quilt and purple LED cove wash date it, and towel stacks left on the bed keep it firmly in support territory.

frames.subject: Old stone church with tiled apses behind a garden of roses
frames.reason: Flat cloudy light, soft low-resolution detail and a centred postcard composition; it is heritage sightseeing content, not property imagery.
frames.flagReason: A historic Cretan monastery church and its public garden - area or destination content, not the estate.

frames.subject: Two-storey white villa lit at twilight above a glowing turquoise pool
frames.reason: Handsome dusk architecture with warm interior lights and a bright pool, but a utility pole and power lines cross the pink sky at the left edge, more cables run at the right, and blue sling loungers crowd the near corner.

frames.subject: Property nameplate on a weathered wooden post against a pale sky
frames.reason: Nine tenths empty sky with a small signboard on a post at the right edge; a wayfinding record rather than a photograph of anything.

frames.subject: Lit villa terrace at blue hour with a glowing green pool along a stone wall
frames.reason: Real and usable, and the light is the best argument in the set — deep blue dusk, warm wall lamps, a glowing timber door and the pool leading the eye — but not the hero the other grader called it. At 2.2x the lower left is a litter of grey sling chairs at random angles with two cut by the frame edge, an orange life ring is propped against the stone wall, and a power cable crosses the sky with a pole and crossarm behind the foliage. The strewn-chair foreground is precisely what the curator rejected in the lawn frame; here it spoils a quadrant rather than the whole picture, so it lands at support.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a sandy cove under deep blue sea
frames.reason: Superb sea colour and a clean horizon over the private cove, but the raised viewpoint flattens it into a plan view, midday sun kills the modelling, and a broad yellow plywood ramp dominates the foreground.

frames.subject: White bedroom with folded robes on the bed and the sea beyond the balcony doors
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other white bedroom and no stronger. Same flat over-white light with no separation, the same socket run and wall fitting sitting dead centre, the same robes piled on the bed, and the bed now fills the lower half. Nothing is gained over the other take.

frames.subject: Palm trees and a string of bulbs reflected in still blue pool water
frames.reason: Graphic and quiet - the diagonal line of festoon bulbs against palm silhouettes works as an abstract texture - but it is a single flat cyan tone and tells a visitor nothing about the place, so it is a section break, not a hero.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining area with a wooden table, flowers and a retro fridge
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit and a black speaker box high on the left wall, dishwasher and oven fronts, and a coloured knife block on the counter - appliance and utility clutter across the frame.

frames.subject: Wooden playground beside a lit villa with the sun setting over the sea
frames.reason: Beautiful dusk sky wasted on a swing set and slide on artificial turf, with dark foreground shrubs and staked saplings blocking both edges; reads as a family park, not a luxury estate.

frames.subject: Blue quad bike parked on a dirt track in front of woodland
frames.reason: A vehicle product shot on a sand track with dense green deciduous woodland behind - no light, no composition, nothing of the property.
frames.flagReason: Generic ATV stock photography; the birch-and-scrub woodland is not Cretan coastal landscape and nothing of the estate appears.

frames.subject: White cubic villa with pool, lawn and sun loungers under hard midday sun
frames.reason: Clean architecture and turquoise water, but flat harsh noon light with hard shadows, a lounger cropped at the bottom-left corner and a fruit bowl and outdoor kitchen cluttering the mid-ground. Real and usable as support, not a full-bleed hero.

frames.subject: Stacked white pebbles lettered Spirit, Body and Mind held in an open palm over soft bokeh
frames.reason: A generic wellness graphic with text burned into the stones and a studio bokeh background; nothing of the property is in frame. Same species as the curated stock rejects.
frames.flagReason: Generic wellness stock image with overlaid lettering; carries no property content whatsoever.

frames.subject: Wooden signpost carrying the estate's name board against a clear blue sky
frames.reason: Sharp, cleanly exposed, well placed against an even blue sky with generous copy space at the left — genuinely useful as a section divider or headline plate, and it carries the estate's own branding rather than a third party's, so it confirms the property rather than casting doubt on it. Only a small identifying detail though: it is wayfinding, with no light quality and no sense of place, so it can never lead.

frames.subject: Guests gathered around a draped cocktail table under a canopy at the shoreline at sunset
frames.reason: The sunset light is warm, but a pop-up event marquee dominates the middle of the frame, a green plastic tub sits centre-bottom on the concrete and guests are shown from behind. Event gear and plastic clutter, the register the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Kitchen sink and mixer tap with coloured plastic bowls and a knife block
frames.reason: Tilted snapshot framing, brightly coloured plastic kitchenware and a triple wall socket in the background, all rendered in shallow focus. Cheap props and crooked horizon.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and living area with a pastel fridge, wooden table and teal sofa
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit sits high on the wall in the upper centre of the frame, the exact defect the standard names first. Flat ceiling light on top of that.

frames.subject: Wooden play frame and swings on artificial turf at dusk, lit buildings and sea behind
frames.reason: Reads as a family park rather than a luxury villa, matching the curated playground reject, and the foreground is choked by shrubs and staked saplings that block the view through. The sunset sky cannot rescue it.

frames.subject: Small branded shower-gel bottle tucked into rolled white towels on a bed
frames.reason: A tight amenity product shot with no property context at all, and the label is a third-party cosmetics brand shot sideways. Reads as product photography rather than villa imagery.
frames.flagReason: Frame is dominated by another company's product branding and shows nothing identifiable of the estate.

frames.subject: Hot tub on a timber deck beside a slatted fence and tall reeds
frames.reason: An overhead cable runs across the sky at the right, the timber fence and reed bank fill the background with no view out, and the midday light is hard and shadowless on the tub. Cables and utility surroundings are named C defects.

frames.subject: Twin bedroom in white with a wooden headboard and glazed door to a terrace
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit is mounted prominently on the wall above the beds, centre-left in frame. Otherwise a competent interior, but the standard rejects AC units outright.

frames.subject: Breakfast buffet table by the sea with bread basket, croissants, jam jars and branded leaflets
frames.reason: Catering set-up with jars, condiments and a leaflet holder crowding the cloth, shot with a heavily out-of-focus fruit platter blocking the bottom third. Buffet documentation, the opposite of the register wanted.

frames.subject: Aerial view of an evening pool party with dining tables, palms and the sea beyond
frames.reason: Handsome overhead of a real event on the property with the shoreline behind, but busy with guests, service tables and a van and cars parked at the right edge, under a blown white sky. Event documentation, usable but never full bleed.

frames.subject: Straight-down aerial of a coastal strip with fields, villas, pools and shoreline
frames.reason: A top-down satellite-style plate rather than a photograph: no light, no composition, no human viewpoint. Useful only as a location diagram.
frames.flagReason: The frame covers many neighbouring plots, hotels and pools; there is no way to tell from it which buildings are this estate.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and white loungers on a pebble beach beside turquoise water and rocks
frames.reason: Vivid water and a genuine private-beach scene, but shot in hard midday light with black shadows, a wooden walkway cutting diagonally through the foreground and a lounger clipped at the right edge. Strong support, short of the golden-hour beach frames that earn A.

frames.subject: Staff in white shirts carrying a platter of grilled aubergine canapes and a bowl of pasta salad
frames.reason: Catering service documentation with bodies cropped headless across the frame and a plain concrete floor behind. Exactly the catering register the standard rules out.

frames.subject: Round dining tables and festoon lights set around a pool at dusk with palms and the sea behind
frames.reason: Real, warm and well balanced with the horizon centred behind the pool, but it is event documentation: guests mid-movement, a stroller, a speaker stand and a blown white sky. Good support, not hero.

frames.subject: Small estate name plate on a wooden post against an empty blue sky
frames.reason: The sign occupies a fraction of the frame and the remaining four fifths is featureless sky; the plate itself is slightly skewed. Snapshot signage with nothing of the place in it.

frames.subject: Laid dinner table under pop-up canopies beside a swimming pool
frames.reason: A beer bottle held by the photographer intrudes into the bottom-left corner, folding chairs and marquee poles clutter the middle, and the pop-up canopy fabric fills the top third. Snapshot framing with event gear throughout.

frames.subject: Bartender measuring a pour behind an outdoor timber bar with racked wine glasses
frames.reason: Same defects as the other frame from this sequence and no better. The subject is cropped headless, plastic squeeze bottles with green and yellow pour spouts are lined along the left edge, foil-capped liquor bottles stand across the counter and a black plastic tray sits at the right. Warm side light and racked glassware cannot carry a frame built on service clutter.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a wooden headboard, driftwood ornaments and a marble ensuite through the doorway
frames.reason: Soft even daylight, crisp linen and real depth through to the marble ensuite carry it. Held back by the artwork sliced by the top edge, the bed cut across the bottom, switch and socket plates on show, and a green bottle and slippers left on the duvet. Real and usable gallery support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Hands filling a cut-glass tumbler from a drinks dispenser labelled Ice Tea
frames.reason: Artificial plastic ivy trails across the right of the frame and a black rubber bar mat fills the foreground; a chalk service label and a wristwatch complete the catering feel. Service props, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Lit pool and palms against a pink and blue dusk sky over the sea
frames.reason: The best frame in the set: blue-hour gradient, palms standing clean against the sky, the glowing pool leading to a level sea horizon, white parasols and cabanas balanced left and right, and not a person or a cable in it. Quiet, controlled and expensive-looking, full-bleed capable.

frames.subject: Guests seated on floor cushions at the shore watching the sun set over the sea
frames.reason: Genuinely warm golden light with the headland silhouetted on the horizon, but it is people-led and shot from behind, with patterned cushions and cloths and a gravel foreground that reads dated. Real and usable support.

frames.subject: Pool with palms and guests at golden hour, sea beyond a white terrace wall
frames.reason: Snapshot framing with a soft phone-camera look: a lens flare washing the left, a purple event light on a stand mid-frame, guests scattered without arrangement and a large empty expanse of pool water across the bottom.

frames.subject: Barley rusk topped with chopped tomato and crumbled cheese on a white plate
frames.reason: A tight food plate shot on a plain white surface with blurred tomatoes behind: no property context, no place, indistinguishable from commercial food photography.
frames.flagReason: Generic studio-style food shot with nothing of the estate in frame; cannot be verified as the property's own imagery.

frames.subject: Sun setting over the sea behind a headland, with tall cane silhouetted in the foreground
frames.reason: Lovely colour and a calm horizon, but the left half is a heavy dark mass of scrubby cane and the frame carries nothing of the property. Atmospheric support rather than a hero.

frames.subject: Villa terrace at dusk with a green-lit pool, stone boundary wall and warm exterior lights
frames.reason: Controlled blue-hour light and a beautifully lit pool, but overhead wires cross the sky above the wall at the left, grey chairs are cut off in the near foreground and a large blank white wall takes the right third. Very good support, just short of hero.

frames.subject: Bartender pouring from a bottle into a shaker at an outdoor bar in low golden light
frames.reason: Warm light and an on-story pour, but a row of plastic squeeze bottles with green and yellow caps runs along the foreground and a black plastic bus tray sits at the right — catering plastic in frame — and the subject is cut off at the top edge.

frames.subject: Chrome basin tap against a veined marble wall
frames.reason: A fixture close-up with no property context: the marble matches the bathrooms elsewhere in the set, but on its own it reads as a plumbing catalogue shot with a large empty out-of-focus right half.
frames.flagReason: Branded fixture close-up with no property context; reads as generic product imagery and cannot be tied to this estate.

frames.subject: White marble bathroom with a tub, glass shower and a slot window onto a daybed
frames.reason: Bright and clean with a nice glimpse through the internal window, but the tub is sliced by the bottom-left corner, the window highlights are blown out and a broad blank wall carries the centre. Flat and undemonstrative, usable support.

frames.subject: Gardener kneeling among young plantings in a dry field with the sea behind
frames.reason: Documentary of groundwork that reads as a farm rather than a villa, with bare dry earth across the middle, an overhead cable across the sky at the right and cars parked on the road behind. Matches the curated gardener reject exactly.

frames.subject: Lit pool, sun loungers and a parasol on a terrace against a peach-to-blue dusk sky
frames.reason: Beautiful dusk gradient wasted: a utility pole and overhead wires cross the sky at centre-left with a second pole and line at the right, a vehicle is parked beyond the stone wall, and an orange life ring hangs on the stonework. Cables and poles across the sky are a stated reject.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and white loungers on a pebble beach beside turquoise water
frames.reason: Genuinely the private shoreline and the water colour is excellent, but it is hard midday light with a flat blue sky, the nearest umbrella canopy crops awkwardly across the whole top edge, and the foreground is busy with roll-out wooden matting, an ice bucket on a stand and small signs on the posts. Real and usable support, not a clean full-bleed hero.

frames.subject: Twin beds pushed together with folded towels, sparkling wine and a wall-mounted air conditioner above
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit sits high in the frame directly above the bed, which the standard rejects outright. Beyond that the light is flat, the room reads narrow with a small high slot window, and the right edge is blocked by a cropped wooden cabinet.

frames.subject: Bubbling outdoor hot tub against a stone wall and slatted timber fence
frames.reason: Utility clutter in frame: a grey condenser unit on the wall behind and a white boiler tank beside it, plus the tub's own control panel and grille in the centre. A stray folding chair sits on the grass. This is the curator's rejected hot-tub-with-AC case.

frames.subject: Seated guests watching the sun set over the sea from a rocky shoreline terrace
frames.reason: The sunset itself is lovely but the lower half of the frame is black plastic stacking chairs and the backs of guests' heads; a catering canopy and trestle table intrude at the left edge. Plastic furniture and snapshot event documentation, exactly the register the standard excludes.

frames.subject: Round table laid with glassware and linen beside a pool at sunset
frames.reason: Beautiful soft backlight, shallow depth and expensive-looking coloured glassware — close to hero. Held back by two branded plastic water bottles standing dead centre of the table and blurred figures sitting on the pool edge behind. Strong support frame, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Outdoor dining tables under an orange shade sail, gardens and white villas beyond
frames.reason: Shows the shaded terrace and grounds honestly with a sliver of sea, but it is harsh midday light with heavy contrast, the shade sail eats the top third, and there is clutter at the edges — a green tarpaulin structure at left and coloured recycling bins at right. Usable support, no more.

frames.subject: Palm trees and a string of bulbs reflected in still blue pool water
frames.reason: Simple graphic composition and an unusually restrained frame for this library. But the light is flat dusk with no modelling, it is an abstract detail rather than a subject, and a plain white blowout runs along the top edge. Good atmospheric support, not a hero that sells the estate.

frames.subject: Bright bedroom with a wooden headboard, ceiling fan and a window onto green foliage
frames.reason: Clean, well exposed and tidily dressed, with a pleasant green window view. Not hero: flat interior light, a blank white wardrobe filling the left half as dead space, and a blue item cropped into the bottom-left corner. Straight support imagery.

frames.subject: Night party of guests dressed in white around a lit pool under strings of bulbs
frames.reason: Event documentation — crowds, white folding chairs and catering tables — with a dead black sky and a large expanse of bare dirt filling the whole foreground. Busy, dark and snapshot-framed.

frames.subject: Crate of tomatoes, courgettes and aubergines at the edge of a vegetable plot
frames.reason: Reads as a working farm rather than a luxury villa, the same fault as the curator's rejected gardener frame. Harsh midday sun, blown blue sky, dusty bare soil, and the produce crate is clumsily cropped by the bottom edge.

frames.subject: Small private pool edged with purple LED strip lighting at dusk
frames.reason: Utility poles and overhead cables cross the sky above the treeline behind the fence — a named defect. A white pool-cleaner unit and its hose sit in the middle of the water, the LED strip reads as disco lighting rather than expensive, and the upper half is empty sky.

frames.subject: Aerial view of white flat-roofed villas with small pools among dry farm fields
frames.reason: The estate occupies only the centre of the frame; the rest is parched ploughed fields, a concrete helipad with a parked helicopter and car, and utility poles. Harsh midday light, no sea, documentary rather than editorial.

frames.subject: Palms silhouetted against a twilight sky above a lit pool with the sea beyond
frames.reason: The best light in this batch — warm-to-blue gradient, palm silhouettes, string bulbs and clean reflections. Kept off hero grade by soft snapshot-grade capture, a slightly tilted horizon, magenta LED wash that cheapens the register, and cropped figures and a table cluttering the right edge.

frames.subject: Paved garden paths winding between white villas at sunset with the sea behind
frames.reason: Handsome dusk sky and buried path lighting, then ruined by clutter: yellow and green recycling bins in the bottom-left corner, red buckets on a timber crate bottom-right, and a cable strung across the sky from the villa at left.

frames.subject: Private pool behind a dry-stone wall with loungers, umbrella and sea beyond
frames.reason: Clean and appealing, with good turquoise water and a real sea view over the wall. Midday light is hard and the sky is an empty blue slab across the top; an orange life ring, a white utility cabinet at the right edge and a neighbouring pink building intrude. Solid support frame.

frames.subject: Whirlpool bath with running jets beside a window looking out to the sea
frames.reason: A coiled chrome shower hose is dumped over the rim at the optical centre, the tub is sliced by two edges so it never reads as an object, half the frame is blank marble rendering flat grey, and the sea view is reduced to a strip above bare rooftop parapets. A record of a fitting rather than an image.

frames.subject: Terrace with a turquoise plunge pool, loungers and white villa wall, sea in the distance
frames.reason: Strong showing of the indoor-outdoor living and a genuine sea horizon, well exposed. Midday sun gives hard shadows and an empty blue sky over the top half, the wide lens stretches the corners, and an orange life ring plus a cropped bench at the right edge break the calm. Good support.
frames.flagReason: Composition and finishes match the other estate frames, but the sea sits far off past open scrub rather than close by, so worth a quick confirmation this is the same grounds.

frames.subject: Greens steaming in a large iron pot over an open wood fire in a sooty hearth
frames.reason: Dark, murky documentary snapshot: soot-blackened brick fills the frame, a bare forearm is cropped into the bottom-right corner and a white object intrudes along the bottom edge. Nothing here reads as a luxury villa.
frames.flagReason: A rustic open hearth with no property context at all; could as easily be an off-site cooking-class kitchen as anything on the estate.

frames.subject: Elevated view of a poolside gathering at dusk with palms and the sea behind
frames.reason: Real and usable event coverage that shows the pool terrace, palms and shoreline together. Not hero: the sky is blown to featureless white, a parked white van sits at the right edge, and chairs and a table are cropped along the bottom. Documentation, not editorial.

frames.subject: White bedroom with robes on the bed and balcony doors opening to the sea
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits prominently at the top right, the named reject. Also an exposed run of sockets and cabling on the wall left of the bed, and flat frontal light across a very white room.

frames.subject: Timber play frame and swing on artificial turf beside a lit villa at dusk
frames.reason: A wooden playground on artificial grass, which the curator rejected outright as reading like a family park rather than a luxury villa. The lovely sunset strip is also largely blocked by unruly foliage crowding both foreground corners.

frames.subject: Candles in glass holders stepping down a whitewashed stair at dusk
frames.reason: Quiet and atmospheric, with warm flames against cool blue-hour white — the most restrained frame here. Short of hero because the top third is a muddle of fence, bare tree and a hanging towel, the capture is soft, and it carries no sense of the property itself.

frames.subject: Lit pool at dusk with strings of bulbs and guests gathered at tables behind
frames.reason: Utility poles and overhead power lines cut across the sky at the left and centre, and the pool deck is busy with marquees, trestle tables and a loudspeaker. Handsome twilight wasted on cable clutter and event documentation.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and covered terrace looking onto a private pool
frames.reason: Useful frame showing the kitchen, shaded seating and pool in one view, and the light inside is even. Held to support grade by a black chair cropped hard across the bottom edge, thin overhead cables visible through the gap to the garden, and a pool float and grab rail cluttering the water.

frames.subject: Bedroom with sliding glass doors onto a terrace, towels and a bouquet on the bed
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: a slab of brown wardrobe fills the left third, the bed is sliced off by the right edge with the bouquet cropped in the corner, and a large blank white wall carries the middle. Flat light and no subject.

frames.subject: White villa exterior with external stair, umbrella and a private pool
frames.reason: A grey air-conditioning condenser sits against the wall at the foot of the staircase and power cables cross the sky in the top-left corner — both named defects. Otherwise hard midday light, a bare blue sky, and flip-flops and pool hardware littering the deck.

frames.subject: Guests on floor cushions at low tables watching the sun set over the sea
frames.reason: Real and warm, with genuinely good sunset colour on the water and headland. People-led and shot from behind, so it is backs of heads across the middle of the frame with a wide band of dull grey shingle along the bottom. Support, not hero.

frames.subject: Guests dining at tables beside a lit pool under strings of bulbs at dusk
frames.reason: Attractive dusk palette with palms and the sea horizon, and it sells the private-event story. But it is busy event documentation — pale folding chairs scattered across a bare concrete deck, a bin and a music stand at the left — and the large grey foreground is empty. Usable, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Guests in white gathered around a pool under a blown-out pale sky
frames.reason: A utility pole with power lines stands clear against the sky at the left, the sky itself is blown to flat white with no tone, and the pool deck is crowded with loungers, umbrellas and catering. Flat light plus cables, both named rejects.

frames.subject: Hands filling a cut-glass tumbler from an iced tea dispenser on a bar
frames.reason: Catering-counter detail with a black rubber bar mat, a chalk label and plastic ivy garland filling the frame; the arms are cropped at the edges and the background is a blur of more dispensers. Clutter with no property in sight.
frames.flagReason: A tight beverage-service close-up with no property context whatsoever — indistinguishable from generic catering or stock imagery. Confirm it was shot on site.

frames.subject: Pedestrians walking through a stone archway into an old town shopping street
frames.reason: A public town street, not the estate: shopfronts, an awning, a wall-mounted lamp, and conduit and cabling running down both facades and across the sky beyond the arch. Dull flat light and dead-centre snapshot framing.
frames.flagReason: A historic archway on a public old-town street with shops and passers-by, plainly a town centre rather than any part of the estate. Area content at best, never property imagery.

frames.subject: Guests dancing barefoot on a concrete terrace beside a thatched bar
