frames.reason: Party documentation: a loudspeaker on a black tripod and cables at the left, a spandex-skirted cocktail table, a marquee behind, and utility poles with wires against a washed-out sky. Awkward mid-motion snapshot with a large empty grey floor.

frames.subject: Cars parked under canopies beside a white villa and a paved forecourt
frames.reason: Three parked cars fill the right-of-centre, a brushed-steel gate pillar blocks the whole right edge, and the light is hard midday. Reads as a car park, not a villa.

frames.subject: Swimming pool glowing green at dusk beside a white villa terrace
frames.reason: Genuine blue-hour light, lit pool and warm wall lamp, but the right third is a blank white wall and door, three chairs are cropped hard at the bottom edge and an orange lifebuoy hangs on the stone wall. Good support, not clean enough for full bleed.

frames.subject: Timber outdoor shower on a lawn above a calm blue sea
frames.reason: Green plastic construction netting behind the reeds, a dark timber shower block cropped down the right edge with exposed plumbing, and half the frame is empty midday sky. Clutter and snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Bamboo-screened terrace looking over a meadow to the sea
frames.reason: A power cable cuts across the sky at right and a utility pole stands in the field; bare construction dirt behind the wall and flat overhead light. Cables and site clutter.

frames.subject: Rolled towel and a small toiletry bottle on a made white bed
frames.reason: Nearly the whole frame is out of focus, a wall socket sits on the headboard behind, and the only sharp element is a branded amenity bottle. Snapshot detail with no property register.
frames.flagReason: A tight branded-toiletry close-up on generic white bedding, indistinguishable from stock hotel amenity photography; worth confirming it was shot in a villa here.

frames.subject: Lit villa blocks and a paved forecourt at dusk with parked cars
frames.reason: Handsome dusk sky, but overhead power lines and a pole cross the upper left, a car boot fills the bottom right corner and more cars sit under the carport. Cables plus vehicles.

frames.subject: Pool lit blue at dusk with a palm reflected and sunset sea behind
frames.reason: The palm reflection in the still water is lovely and the dusk gradient is real, but the deck is strewn with bags, towels and a rucksack, and the magenta LED wash plus a pop-up gazebo read as event set-up. Usable support.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate beside a doorway with a pool blurred behind
frames.reason: A gold door jamb splits the frame down the middle, everything except the sign is out of focus, and the composition is an accident rather than a choice.

frames.subject: Rows of blue umbrellas on a sandy bay below rocky cliffs
frames.reason: Beautiful turquoise water and a strong headland, but it is a serviced public beach with a hotel and taverna above it, busy with bathers, shot in flat midday light. Handsome, not the private shoreline.
frames.flagReason: Organised beach with rows of hired umbrellas, a taverna and an accommodation block on the hillside; a public bay, not the estate's own beach.

frames.subject: Property nameplate on a wooden post against a clear sky
frames.reason: Two thirds of the frame is empty blue sky and the subject is a laminated sign on a pole. No property content at all.

frames.subject: Domed stone ruin on a hilltop above a dirt track
frames.reason: A monument, not a villa: rutted dirt road through the foreground, a utility pole and guy wires at right, a parked car behind and soft low-resolution capture.
frames.flagReason: Historic stone building with a dome on open hillside, reached by a public track; area content, not Thalasses.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a rocky shore by turquoise water
frames.reason: The private shoreline looks its best in the water colour, but this is hard overhead light with no modelling, the foreground is taken up by timber steps and dry scrub, and a wooden bin sits in the bottom right. Strong support frame.
frames.flagReason: A small multicoloured logo mark sits on the sand near the lower-right corner, which reads as a watermark burned into the file.

frames.subject: Festoon lights and palm silhouettes above a blue-lit pool at dusk
frames.reason: The one hero frame in the batch: a lilac-to-amber dusk gradient, three palms in silhouette, a single sagging string of bulbs drawn across the sky, and a mirror-still lit pool filling the lower third with clean space for a headline. Cinematic and expensive-looking.

frames.subject: Blue-lit pool at dusk with loungers, umbrellas and a palm reflection
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the stronger frame with the string lights removed; the deck now shows bags, hanging towels and a stacked lounger, and the composition sits lower and flatter. Real and usable, not hero.

frames.subject: White marble bathroom with a corner whirlpool tub, washbasin and a novelty fish ornament
frames.reason: Bright and correctly exposed, but the WC sits at the centre of the frame with a folded cloth dumped on the lid, exposed hose fittings, a brush and a wire towel rack beside it, novelty fish ornaments on the shelf and tub surround, and the window blown to white. Inventory framing, not editorial.

frames.subject: Wide sandy beach with umbrellas below mountains and cloud
frames.reason: Genuinely handsome light on the mountains and good cloud, but it is a long public beach with hired sunbeds and bathers, and the foreground is a tangle of dry scrub. Landscape support at best.
frames.flagReason: A long public beach lined with commercial sunbed rows below a coastal village; not the estate's shoreline.

frames.subject: Glass of orange juice and half an orange on a small wooden table
frames.reason: Warm colour and clean styling make a serviceable breakfast detail, but the horizon is noticeably tilted, the chair back is a shapeless white mass in the corner and most of the frame is out-of-focus lawn. Small-tile use only.

frames.subject: Breakfast table and chair on a white terrace facing the sea
frames.reason: Clean white architecture with a real sea view and nice styling, but a power line and poles run across the neighbouring rooftops at left, there is bare construction ground beyond the wall, and the midday sun leaves a large flat white wall dominating the frame.

frames.subject: Aerial view of white villas beside dry fields and a helipad
frames.reason: Useful as a site plan and nothing more: parched brown fields fill most of the frame, a service yard with a van and stacked junk sits at right, and the overhead noon light is completely flat.

frames.subject: White kitchen with a mint retro fridge and a pineapple on the table
frames.reason: Tidy, bright and well styled with the pineapple and turquoise bowl carrying the colour, but it is a small galley kitchen led by appliances and branded logos, evenly lit and without a view. Solid support.

frames.subject: Small property sign on a wooden post against pale blue sky
frames.reason: Around eighty per cent of the frame is blank sky and the sign is too small to read. An empty frame.

frames.subject: Whitewashed entrance gateway with palms and planters, a glimpse of sea through the arch
frames.reason: A considered symmetrical arrival frame that identifies the property, with a nice sightline through the arch. Not hero: the sky is blown to paper white across the whole top of the frame, the bottom third is empty grey asphalt, and a camper is parked behind the wall at the left. Usable small, not full bleed.

frames.subject: Open-plan dining room with folding doors onto a pool and sea
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits high on the right wall with speaker boxes either side and a cropped TV bracket in the top left corner. Exactly the utility clutter the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate on a white wall beside a timber gate
frames.reason: More than half the frame is a blown-out white void, the subject is a small sign at the extreme left edge and a fence panel floats at the right. Nothing to look at.

frames.subject: White cubic villa exterior at blue hour with a lit green pool and timber deck
frames.reason: The strongest frame in this set — controlled blue-hour light, warm interior glow against the cool sky, and the lit pool leading the eye into clean architecture. Short of hero: a utility pole and wires cross the sky beside the building, a downpipe runs the full height of the white wall, and a chrome ladder plus a white plastic pool step cropped at the bottom edge break the foreground. Those would all be visible at full bleed.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub looking out to a fence and a neighbouring building
frames.reason: Overhead cables and a utility pole cross the sky behind the fence, a warning notice is pinned to the boards, a shower post stands centre frame, and the view from the tub is a boundary fence rather than the sea.

frames.subject: Hazy view from a stony mountain ridge over the coast and sea
frames.reason: Phone-snapshot capture with heavy atmospheric haze, no horizon interest and a foreground of loose grey scree. Nothing of the property in frame.
frames.flagReason: An open mountain summit looking down at a distant coastline; area or excursion content, not the estate.

frames.subject: Two shaded low tables with cushions on a rocky shore at sunset
frames.reason: The dressed tables, lanterns and low sun sell the private-dining story, but the sun has blown the upper sky to bare white, the pop-up gazebos read as hired aluminium frames, and the lower half is a wide expanse of raked brown sand with a lens flare in it.

frames.subject: Open-plan living space with a turquoise fridge and a bedroom beyond
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit is cropped into the top right corner, and the framing is estate-agent wide with the bottom half given over to empty polished floor.

frames.subject: Sun loungers and a parasol beside a small pool with the sea beyond
frames.reason: Real, appealing and clearly the sea-facing terrace, but shot in flat midday sun, with a blue towel bundled on the foreground table, two chairs sliced off at the bottom corners and a thin cable crossing the sea view.

frames.subject: Paved garden path between white villas and planted borders
frames.reason: Tidy and clutter-free with a good curve through the planting and a glimpse of sea at the end, but it is a landscaping record: harsh noon light, hard shadows and an empty upper half of sky.

frames.subject: Dressed dinner table beside a pool at golden hour
frames.reason: Warm low light, good linen, glassware and a floral centrepiece, but two branded plastic water bottles stand dead centre on the table and the background is blown almost to white behind the seated guests. Usable for the dining story after a crop.

frames.subject: Turquoise plunge pool and paved terrace with a dry field and utility poles behind
frames.reason: Air-conditioning condenser unit visible beside the outdoor kitchen, two utility poles and overhead cables cutting across the sky, and a burnt dry field filling the middle distance under hard midday sun. Exactly the utility clutter the standard rejects.

frames.subject: Kitchen counter with a coffee machine, capsule bowl, purple mixing bowl and sink
frames.reason: Snapshot detail crop of a worktop: coloured plastic knives, a purple bowl and a blue board make it read as clutter rather than styling, and the vertical framing cuts the oven and cabinets awkwardly. Flat interior light.
frames.flagReason: A third-party coffee-machine logo and branded capsule box sit centre frame, the same objection the curator raised against the branded coffee-machine close-up.

frames.subject: Wooden playground with slide and swings on artificial turf beside white buildings
frames.reason: Direct match for the curator's rejected playground frame: play equipment on green rubber matting reads as a family park, not a luxury villa. Power lines and a utility pole cross the sky, and a blue plastic drum sits at the right edge.

frames.subject: Green-lit pool at dusk with loungers, a stone wall and the sea under a sunset sky
frames.reason: The strongest frame in the batch: sunset gradient over an open sea horizon, controlled pool lighting, deck lights picking out the timber and stone. Reads expensive and would carry a full bleed, matching the curator's A-grade dusk pool frames. The small utility cabinet on the wall is retouchable and does not break it.

frames.subject: DJ working a mixer and laptop beside a pool at a party
frames.reason: Event documentation dominated by equipment: PA speaker on a stand, trailing cables, flight case and laptop fill the frame, and the sky is blown to paper white. Kit in frame is the opposite of the register wanted.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub set into a wooden deck beside artificial grass
frames.reason: Tight snapshot crop with no context: the moulded acrylic shell and its control pad dominate, artificial turf reads cheap, and a metal trolley wheel intrudes at the top right corner.

frames.subject: Open wooden gate looking through to a pool terrace with parasols and mountains beyond
frames.reason: Real and usable, with soft late light and a nice framing device in the gate. Held back from hero by a rough concrete and rubble foreground, a dark bag and towels draped over the walls on both sides, and a guest sitting mid-frame that makes it feel like a grab shot.

frames.subject: Open-plan kitchen and seating area with a mint fridge, teal sofa and dining bar
frames.reason: A wall-mounted air-conditioning unit sits high in the frame with an alarm sensor beside it, the worktop carries a blue board, a coloured knife block and small appliances, and the light is flat and frontal with no modelling. AC in frame is the curator's stated reject.

frames.subject: Close-up of bed pillows on a tilted horizon with a candle and a figurine behind
frames.reason: Crooked snapshot framing with the whole scene rotated, most of the right half is empty wall, and a kitsch doll ornament and dried flowers date the styling badly.

frames.subject: Three labelled drink dispensers and ice buckets on a dressed event table
frames.reason: Catering gear shot flat against a blown-white sky, with plastic ivy garland and a black rubber cable mat along the front edge. The curator rejected buffet equipment on exactly these grounds.

frames.subject: White villa exterior with a turquoise pool, blue sling chairs and a parasol
frames.reason: Overhead power lines and a utility pole run across the sky at the left, an antenna mast rises at the right edge, and the blue metal sling chairs read cheap. Hard midday sun with black shadows and no modelling.

frames.subject: Pool corner with an outdoor shower pole, wooden fence and a grill counter
frames.reason: Awkward vertical crop that slices the outdoor kitchen unit in half at the left, puts the shower pole dead centre, and cuts a hot tub rim across the bottom. Harsh midday light and no clear subject.

frames.subject: Hot tub with a champagne bucket and towels, sea and headland beyond
frames.reason: Usable: strong sea colour and a real sense of the shoreline setting. Not hero grade because the parasol crops hard into the top-left corner, the upper half is empty sky, and the middle distance is busy with parked cars, buildings and a lounger carrying wrapped items.

frames.subject: Pool lit blue at dusk beneath festoon lights and palm silhouettes, sea behind
frames.reason: Lovely twilight colour and reflections in the still water, but technically soft, the horizon sits slightly off level, and blurred figures plus a table and stray objects clutter the right edge. Good support, not clean enough for full bleed.

frames.subject: Sun setting over the sea behind a distant headland, seen across a dark rocky shore
frames.reason: Hazy, low-contrast light with the sun a flat pale disc, and the bottom of the frame is an undifferentiated dark band of scrub and rock with a piece of driftwood at the right. Soft, video-still quality and nothing of the property in it. The headland profile matches the horizon in the on-property dining frame, so I am not flagging it.
frames.flagReason: A bare seascape with nothing of the property in frame; cannot be confirmed as the estate's own shoreline rather than any stretch of the Crete coast.

frames.subject: View from a living room through open sliding doors to a pool, stone wall and the sea
frames.reason: Clean, well-balanced interior-to-sea frame with good natural light and a strong sea band. Kept off hero by a black wall-mounted box top right, a power line crossing the sky through the opening, and furniture cropped along the bottom edge.

frames.subject: Stone bastion and corner sentry dome of a seafront Venetian fortress above open water
frames.reason: Flat hazy midday light on a soft, low-detail file, weeds sprouting from the masonry, and the wall wedge fills the frame without composition. Handsome subject, poor photograph.
frames.flagReason: A public coastal fortification, not the estate; usable only as area content, never as property imagery.

frames.subject: Woman with a backpack photographing mountains from a rocky ridge
frames.reason: Generic lifestyle stock: blown white sky, low resolution and soft detail, subject with her back turned and nothing of the property visible.
frames.flagReason: Reads as generic hiking stock photography of the kind the curator rejected alongside the cyclist frames.

frames.subject: Wooden play frame and swing on rubber matting at dusk, uplit buildings and sea beyond
frames.reason: The blue-hour sky, sunset band over the sea and warm uplighting are genuinely good, but the subject is a children's play frame on rubber matting — the curator's stated 'reads as a family park' reject — and the foreground is choked with shrubs, bamboo stakes and a tied sapling growing across the frame.

frames.subject: Couple at a dressed low table with lanterns on the rocks at sunset, sea behind
frames.reason: Warm backlit sun straight down the water, a simple centred composition on a clean horizon, and the private-dining story reads at once. Held back from hero: the light is hazy and low in contrast, the right third burns out to featureless white, both figures are turned away, and the bottom band is a jumble of mismatched floor cushions on dark gravel that loses all detail. Strong support, not the controlled expensive-looking frame an A demands.

frames.subject: Property nameplate sign fixed to a wooden post against a clear blue sky
frames.reason: A signage record, not photography: the sign and post sit against an otherwise empty sky with no setting, light or composition to carry it. Useful as documentation only.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining table with a mint fridge, pineapple bowl and a carved wooden bird
frames.reason: Bright, tidy and genuinely characterful, with a balanced arrangement across the counter line. Flat shadowless frontal light, small appliances lining the worktop and a chair back cut off across the bottom centre keep it to gallery support rather than full bleed. No AC or utility clutter in this one.

frames.subject: Woven baskets and textiles arranged on plinths in a museum display
frames.reason: Low-resolution, flat interior frame of an exhibition stand with an interpretive text panel and a rope barrier across it. No light, no composition, no relation to a villa.
frames.flagReason: A public folk-museum display with signage and visitor barriers, not the estate.

frames.subject: Lawn and paved terrace with an outdoor kitchen counter and two folding chairs
frames.reason: Empty, utilitarian frame dominated by white cabinet doors and a stainless bin, with a security camera on the fence and lightweight folding chairs. Harsh midday sun and an oversaturated sky, no subject.

frames.subject: White cube villa with lawn, dining terrace and a small pool behind a parasol
frames.reason: A chrome outdoor-shower arm juts into the top-left corner across the sky, an air-conditioning condenser sits against the wall at the right behind the chairs, and hard midday sun leaves a large blank white wall and black shadows.

frames.subject: Beach direction sign on a post beside a gravel track running toward the sea
frames.reason: The subject is a signpost over a bare gravel track, with green plastic mesh fencing running down the right side and dry weedy scrub either side. Harsh midday light and an unattractive setting.

frames.subject: Folded white towels, a wicker basket and sprigs of lavender in a marble bathroom corner
frames.reason: Soft warm light and real texture in the wicker, herbs and towelling. The nearest towel is out of focus and fills the lower half, and a blurred white fixture and basin corner clutter the left edge, so the frame never quite resolves. Usable as a detail or spacer, not hero.
frames.flagReason: No property context at all and a legible third-party brand label on the towel; indistinguishable from generic hotel-amenity stock.

frames.subject: White bedroom with bathrobes and rolled towels on the bed and a terrace door beyond
frames.reason: Flat frontal light on a visibly creased and rucked duvet, the bed cut off at both the left and bottom edges, robes and towels bundled untidily across the covers, a picture sliced at the top left, and a large dead white wall through the centre of the frame. Snapshot framing of a plain room.

frames.subject: Adult and small child looking at an illustrated picture book on a wooden floor
frames.reason: Generic lifestyle frame shot from overhead with the faces turned away, no setting visible beyond bare floorboards, and a foreign-language children's book as the focal point.
frames.flagReason: Reads as generic family lifestyle stock with nothing of the property in frame.

frames.subject: Wine barrel, bottles, filled glasses and grapes staged before a vineyard at sunset
frames.reason: An obviously composited commercial product still life: studio-lit foreground objects dropped against a graded vineyard sunset, with impossible lighting between the two halves.
frames.flagReason: Textbook composited stock beverage photography, not the property; the same objection raised against the branded beer product shots.

frames.subject: Guests dining at round tables under festoon lights on an open terrace at dusk
frames.reason: Good blue-hour light and the strung lights give the frame real warmth, but it is event documentation: rows of banquet folding chairs, a white catering marquee at the left, staff in aprons, and a utility pole and cables on the skyline.

frames.subject: Open timber gate onto a pool terrace with palms, guests at a bar and a bald sky above
frames.reason: The symmetry through the gate and the warm light on the palms are pleasant, but the top half is toneless bald sky with a cable and festoon strings strung across it, a utility pole stands at centre-left, the entire foreground is a band of rough patched concrete, and guests are scattered through the middle distance. Flat hazy light and an unresolved composition.

frames.subject: Open-plan living room with a brown sofa, dining table and staircase behind
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit cropped at the top-left corner, appliance clutter along the counter (microwave, kettle, coffee machines, knife block), and a large blank wall filling the left half under flat interior light.

frames.subject: Shaded terrace table framed by an open door, palms and turquoise sea beyond
frames.reason: Hero-grade: the door frame gives a strong simple layering into palms, white cabanas and open sea, the light is clean and luminous, and the whole frame reads expensive and editorial. Full-bleed capable.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub in a lawn corner with an outdoor bar and slatted fence behind
frames.reason: Harsh midday light with hard shadows, a laminated regulation notice on the fence at right, a metal shower post, a stray beanbag and a neighbouring block in frame; the plastic tub rim cuts the bottom-left corner.

frames.subject: Row of cartoon souvenir coasters on a wooden table edge
frames.reason: Tight product close-up with a white cable running across the top-right corner and no property context at all; reads as generic gift-shop photography.
frames.flagReason: Third-party cartoon souvenir branding in tight close-up with nothing of the estate visible; indistinguishable from generic product stock, so it should be confirmed as in-villa photography.

frames.subject: Blue mesh deck chairs beside a small pool with an outdoor sink counter
frames.reason: Harsh midday sun, wide-angle distortion, and the frame is dominated by a utility sink counter and a wall lamp; the mesh chairs read cheap and are cut by the edge.

frames.subject: Kitchen and dining area with a bedroom visible through the doorway
frames.reason: Two air-conditioning units in frame, one over the bedroom door and one on the right wall; flat light and a snapshot split by the white pillar down the centre.

frames.subject: Rectangular pool and palm trees by the sea at sunset with guests around
frames.reason: Snapshot framing: tilted horizon, a large dead expanse of concrete across the foreground, a stray figure with his back to camera in the left third, and glasses and a bottle left on the pool edge.

frames.subject: Chalkboard cocktail list beside beer bottles in an ice bucket on a bar counter
frames.reason: Bar and catering gear shot close, with branded beer labels the most legible thing in frame; the register is exactly the buffet-equipment one the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: Another company's beer branding dominates a bar close-up with no estate signature visible; matches the flagged third-party product frames and should be confirmed before use.

frames.subject: Guests at dinner tables under festoon lights beside a lit pool at sunset
frames.reason: Warm sky, sea and string lights make it real and atmospheric, but it is event documentation: white folding chairs, crowded tables and a wide grey concrete foreground stop it short of full bleed.

frames.subject: Double bedroom with towel swans and a glazed door to a walled patio
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit sits centre frame above the headboard, and the fish triptych plus towel animals date the room; light is flat and the bed is squared off with no strength.

frames.subject: Lit hot tub against a stone wall under a peach dusk sky
frames.reason: Genuinely good blue-hour light on the stone and water, but a laminated notice on the fence, a metal shower post and a neighbouring roofline sit in the middle distance, and the plastic tub shell takes the bottom third.

frames.subject: Bubbling hot tub with an outdoor dining bar and neighbouring building behind
frames.reason: Flat harsh midday light, a regulation sign on the fence, a shower post and a plain white wall closing the right edge; the tub shell fills the lower half.

frames.subject: White villa nameplate on a stone gatepost beside an olive sapling and lawn
frames.reason: A black key lockbox with a padlock hangs directly beneath the nameplate, the frame is split awkwardly by a white wall on the left, and the light is hard midday.

frames.subject: Turquoise private pool with a parasol and blue loungers, sea beyond the wall
frames.reason: Clean white architecture and good pool colour make this usable support, but a blue bag left on the step, a large blank wall on the left and flat noon light keep it off hero duty.

frames.subject: Sea horizon seen over a white terrace wall with bamboo-panelled inserts
frames.reason: The mid-ground is a scrubby vacant lot with a shed and a thin utility pole rising into the horizon line; half the frame is empty sky and the wall runs flat across the bottom.

frames.subject: Chalkboard cocktail list and an ice bucket of beer bottles on a wooden bar
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the other bar frame and no better: catering gear in close-up, branded bottles centre right, busy blurred bar clutter behind.
frames.flagReason: Another company's beer branding is the clearest element and there is no estate context; reads as third-party product imagery and needs confirming.

frames.subject: Close-up of a bubbling hot tub corner with a folded blue towel on the deck
frames.reason: Tight plastic tub shell fills the frame, a sun-lounger wheel and frame intrude at the top-right corner, and artificial turf is visible; a detail snapshot rather than a picture.

frames.subject: Villa facade with a cream parasol and a hot tub in the foreground
frames.reason: A white drainpipe runs straight down the centre of the building, an orange life ring is stuck on the wall, and the tall crop leaves the hot tub as an awkward blue-green mass across the bottom.

frames.subject: Runner crouching to tie a trainer on a sunlit woodland path
frames.reason: Generic sports stock with lens flare and no property in frame at all; exactly the cyclist-into-the-sunset trope the standard excludes.
frames.flagReason: Classic generic fitness stock photography - anonymous cropped athlete on a wooded path with nothing of the estate visible.

frames.subject: Branded shower gel bottle tucked into rolled white towels
frames.reason: Soft-focus amenity close-up where the sharpest element is a third-party product label; no property context and the shallow focus leaves most of the frame mush.
frames.flagReason: Tight branded toiletry product shot with no property context, indistinguishable from generic amenity stock; confirm it was shot in-villa.

frames.subject: Open-plan white living space with a teal sofa, oak dining table and kitchen beyond
frames.reason: Real, clean and usable as an interior support frame — soft even daylight, honest oak-and-white palette, a nice teal sofa anchoring the right. The fittings Grader Two calls disqualifying are minor and edge-placed: the white AC cassette is clipped at the very top edge, the wall speakers are small black cubes high on white walls. What genuinely holds it back is composition — the lower half is bare tiled floor and the actual subject sits small in the upper middle. Support, not full bleed.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a green tray of wine and grapes on the bed and a terrace door beyond
frames.reason: Bright, clean and honestly photographed, with real material interest in the oak headboard shelf and the light coming off the terrace door. Nothing on the C list is present — no hardware, no clutter, no overcast flat grey. The weaknesses are compositional and stylistic: the bed is sliced across the bottom-right by two frame edges, the right third is a blank white wall, and the lime-green plastic tray is dated staging that pulls the eye off everything else. Usable support.

frames.subject: Paved garden path curving between two white villas towards the sea
frames.reason: Real and pleasant - planted borders, white cubic architecture and a glimpse of sea at the end - but harsh midday light, a lot of empty paving in the foreground and a hard blue sky keep it as support.

frames.subject: Open sea and horizon above a white terrace wall with bamboo panels
frames.reason: Two-thirds empty sky over a rough scrub lot with a shed and a slender pole on the horizon; the wall runs flat across the bottom and the light is hard and unmodelled.

frames.subject: Turquoise pool behind a stone wall with a parasol, loungers and a wooden hot tub
frames.reason: Attractive and well-kept with the sea behind, but the top half is a featureless blue sky, the light is flat noon, and an orange life ring on the left wall pulls the eye; good support, not hero.

frames.subject: Poolside at sunset with palm trees, guests and the sea behind
frames.reason: Near-duplicate of the earlier sunset pool frame and just as weak: tilted, phone-grade, a figure's back in the left third, and glassware and a bottle abandoned on the concrete foreground.

frames.subject: Living room with folding doors open onto a pool and the sea
frames.reason: Air-conditioning unit on the right wall and a wall-mounted TV cropped hard at the top-left; the sea view is the good part but the frame is cluttered with props and mismatched artwork.

frames.subject: Poolside gathering at golden hour with palm trees and the sea behind
frames.reason: The upper half is genuinely lovely — calm sea horizon, warm graduated sky, good palm silhouettes — but the lower half is event documentation with the gear left in. A party light on a stand stands centre frame, a white service structure with cables running down it blocks the left foreground, a drinks table with used glassware sits mid-frame, and people are caught mid-movement. Resolution is visibly soft against the rest of the set. Snapshot framing plus production hardware.

frames.subject: White villa block above a paved forecourt with cars under carports
frames.reason: Three parked cars and their carports occupy the right half of the frame; a grey utility gatepost blocks the near right edge and the empty paving fills the foreground.

frames.subject: Private pool lit green at dusk beside a villa terrace
frames.reason: Overhead power cables run across the sky and a concrete utility pole stands in the middle of the skyline - the exact defect the standard names; a folded towel and cushion also crowd the bottom-right corner.

frames.subject: Villa pool lit green at dusk beside a wooden deck and a warmly lit terrace
frames.reason: The best frame here by some distance: controlled blue-hour light, green pool glow against warm interior light, clean deck lines. I am not giving it the A because it does not survive the full-bleed test. The chrome outdoor shower arm and its square head project across the top-left corner against the sky; through the gate gap behind the pool sit a dark parked car, neighbouring rooftops and a pole with wires; and a black wire chair is clipped by the bottom edge. Beautiful light, but too many intrusions for a hero.

frames.subject: Fisherman cleaning an octopus on a stone quay beside moored boats
frames.reason: Documentary snapshot at a working harbour - hulls, nets, winches and wet paving - with nothing of the estate and low, snapshot-grade image quality.
frames.flagReason: A public working fishing harbour with moored commercial boats, not the estate; usable only as area or destination content.

frames.subject: Folded white towels and a wicker basket with lavender against a marble bathroom wall
frames.reason: Soft warm light and real texture — terry towelling, wicker weave, veined marble — which makes it usable as a small supporting detail or a background block. It is weak: the bottom half dissolves into an out-of-focus towel, a cropped white basin corner intrudes at bottom-left, and the white ceramic ornament at top-left is unreadable. But none of that is a C-list defect; the light is directional and pleasant and the register is right. Support only, and small.
frames.flagReason: A supplier's linen brand label (COCO-MAT) is legible on the towel that dominates the frame — third-party branding rather than the estate's own.

frames.subject: Open-plan living room with kitchenette, dining table and sofa
frames.reason: Clean, level, well-exposed interior that reads as real and usable. Flat even light, no view, a black subwoofer box on the floor and a blue plastic bag left on the dining table keep it in support territory.
frames.flagReason: Compact studio layout, sofa bed and retro-fridge styling differ markedly from the white-and-timber villa interiors elsewhere in this set, and nothing in frame ties it to a seafront estate.

frames.subject: Guests dancing on a poolside terrace under festoon lights
frames.reason: Blown-out white sky, guests photographed from behind mid-step, banquet tables and a cloth-draped cocktail table crowding the edges. Event documentation with no light quality.

frames.subject: Tilted view of a washbasin and wall-mounted tap in a marble bathroom
frames.reason: Frame is rotated near ninety degrees with no readable horizon, a light switch sits centre-left, and there is no subject to hold — disorienting snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Outdoor dinner tables under festoon lights at blue hour
frames.reason: Genuinely pretty deep-blue sky and warm catenary lights, but it is event documentation: folding chairs, a white pop-up marquee, and power lines and poles along the skyline. Good support, too busy for full bleed.

frames.subject: Rolled white towels laid on a made bed
frames.reason: All but a sliver of the frame is out of focus, including the towel meant to be the subject, and the composition runs on a hard diagonal with a blurred headboard and lamp. Snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Pool lit blue at dusk with a palm reflection and the sea beyond
frames.reason: Lovely sunset gradient and a strong palm reflection in the water, but towels are flung over the lounger backs and the wall, a black holdall and a handbag sit on the deck, and the magenta uplighting reads nightclub. Clutter costs it the hero slot.

frames.subject: Plate of roasted meat in olive oil with a glass of beer behind
frames.reason: Blown-out white background, hard close crop on fatty meat, unappetising and no property context whatsoever.
frames.flagReason: Plain white surface, shallow depth of field, no Thalasses signature in frame — indistinguishable from generic food stock; confirm it was shot on the property.

frames.subject: Private pool and sun loungers with the sea beyond
frames.reason: A utility pole with two runs of overhead cable crosses the empty sky directly above the pool, magazines are dumped on the lounger and the umbrella is clipped awkwardly at the top corner. Harsh midday light.

frames.subject: Night party around a lit pool, guests dressed in white
frames.reason: Half the frame is dead black sky and a bare dirt-and-concrete foreground; the crowd is a scattering of small figures. Dark event snapshot, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Hands pouring iced tea from a glass dispenser at a drinks table
frames.reason: Catering service detail: black rubber bar mat across the foreground, cropped forearms with a fitness band, chalk label and artificial ivy. The register the standard explicitly excludes.

frames.subject: Bedroom with the door open onto a private pool
frames.reason: Bright and real, and the pool beyond the open door gives it a reason to exist. Sockets and a wall switch sit in frame, a remote sits on the shelf and a dark object is left on the folded towels — good support, not hero.

frames.subject: Illuminated Thalasses sign lit from behind on a wall
frames.reason: Signage close-up shot on a tilt, with the right third falling away into a dim beige panel and the logo's saturated primaries dominating. Corporate signage, not property photography.

frames.subject: Hot tub, sun loungers and a lit pool at dusk
frames.reason: Clean blue-hour light with warm uplighting in the planting, but the hot tub is cropped hard into the bottom corner as a dark plastic shell, an orange life ring hangs on the wall and neighbouring rooftops and a pole show over the fence.

frames.subject: Guests dining beside the pool at sunset with the sea behind
frames.reason: Beautiful pink-to-gold sky, palms and festoon lights over a blue-lit pool — but it is filled with guests' backs and white folding chairs, with a wooden shed at the left. Event documentation, strong support.

frames.subject: Sitting room with a teal sofa and sliding doors to a terrace
frames.reason: Level, bright and honest, with the terrace visible through the glass. Flat light, a TV corner and dark ceramics clipped at the right edge and a fruit bowl cut off at the bottom keep it as support.

frames.subject: Sun lounger dressed with towels and champagne glasses on a deck
frames.reason: A large white utility cabinet fills the right third of the frame and a black speaker is mounted on the timber wall behind. Hard midday shadows across the decking on top of that.

frames.subject: White bedroom with towels folded on the bed and open doorways
frames.reason: An electrical distribution panel is visible on the wall through the open doorway, the whites are blown flat and clinical, and small dark items left on the folded towels break the styling.

frames.subject: Turquoise private pool beside white villa architecture
frames.reason: Strong clean lines, expensive-looking turquoise water and stone wall — the best daylight frame here. Held back by hard midday light, a pale washed-out horizon and a thin power line crossing the upper-left sky.

frames.subject: Dressed wedding tables and festoon lights on a concrete terrace in low sun
frames.reason: The table settings and warm low sun sell the wedding, but more than half the frame is dead: the sky is clipped to featureless white across the top third and the foreground is a bare concrete slab with flare across it. Worse for the register, a shirtless man in swim shorts and guests packing up loungers stand directly behind the dressed tables. Blown sky plus swimwear in a wedding frame.

frames.subject: Villa exterior at dusk with a lit staircase and pool
frames.reason: Handsome pink dusk sky and cool LED-lit stair, but a utility pole and several overhead cables run across the left sky, magazines are left open on the loungers and a lounger is bisected by the bottom-left corner.

frames.subject: White-gloved hand opening the door of a black car
frames.reason: Textbook generic chauffeur stock: cropped gloved hand, anonymous car panel, nothing of the property in frame.
frames.flagReason: Generic luxury-transfer stock photography with no property content at all; the same trope the owner's rule excludes.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and sun loungers on a beach above turquoise water
frames.reason: Spectacular water colour and a real beach service, but this is flat midday light rather than the low sun the hero frames have, and the foreground is a jumble of loungers, a duckboard walkway and umbrella poles with small signboards.

frames.subject: Wooden play frame and trampoline on artificial turf beside a villa
frames.reason: Green rubber-tile play surface, yellow plastic slide and a netted trampoline on bare orange soil — reads as a family park, not a luxury estate.

frames.subject: Villa exterior at dusk with a green-lit pool and sun loungers
frames.reason: Controlled blue-hour exposure: warm interior glow against cool sky, crisp white volumes, the pool lit through green-blue and the timber deck leading in. Looks expensive and holds full bleed; only the small red wall light and the cropped foreground lounger are quibbles.

frames.subject: Row of wine glasses on a rail in front of a trellised vineyard
frames.reason: Product-shot styling against a soft-focus vineyard — no estate, no sea, nothing of the property; the wine-tasting equivalent of the cyclist frames.
frames.flagReason: Generic wine-tasting stock in front of a trellised hillside vineyard; a seafront estate is not this landscape.

frames.subject: Chilled water and glasses on a wooden beach post with the sea behind
frames.reason: Clean light and lovely blue water behind, and it tells the private-sunbed service story. The post splits the frame dead centre, a plastic bottle is the hero object and a lounger is clipped at the corner — support only.

frames.subject: Helicopter parked behind a wire fence beside white buildings
frames.reason: Phone-grade snapshot: a cable slices across the sky, a mesh construction fence runs across the foreground with dry weeds, and the subject is a parked aircraft registration plate.
frames.flagReason: Nothing identifiable of the estate is in frame — a helipad behind a wire fence with generic white buildings; cannot confirm it is this property.

frames.subject: Sun lounger dressed with towels and a pineapple beside a hot tub
frames.reason: A chrome pool ladder rises straight through the middle of the frame and a white plastic moulding is clipped into the bottom-right corner; the staging is cluttered and the pineapple reads as a prop.

frames.subject: Thalasses wordmark and roundel logo on a plain blue background
frames.reason: Not a photograph — a flat logo file on a solid blue field. No light, no subject, nothing of the estate.

frames.subject: Pool reflecting palms at dusk with a wedding arch and the sea behind
frames.reason: Beautiful mirror-still reflection and a soft pink-to-blue sky — the strongest idea in the set. But it reads as a phone frame: soft detail, a guest caught mid-gesture with an arm up, and event kit, a red bag and a draped table crowding both edges.

frames.subject: White bedroom with a wooden headboard and an open bathroom door
frames.reason: Three switch and socket plates sit prominently on the wall, a bathtub is clipped by the right edge, a large empty wall carries the middle of the frame and a tube of something is left on the bed. Flat light, no focal point.

frames.subject: Sandy cove and rocky headland seen from a scrub-covered hillside
frames.reason: Turquoise water and the curving shoreline make a handsome landscape, but the light is hazy midday, the grey foreground rock and dry scrub eat the bottom third, and the scattered umbrellas sit far off. Real and usable as destination content; not full-bleed.
frames.flagReason: A wild open beach with sunbeds and bathers below a headland, reached by a public shore — this is not the estate's own beachfront or its grounds.

frames.subject: Lit swimming pool and festoon lights at blue hour with a party gathering behind
frames.reason: The festoon reflections in the water carry real blue-hour atmosphere, but the defects are the ones the standard names outright: utility poles with wires strung across the sky left of centre, white trestle catering tables with cloths, a marquee, a black speaker on a stand, and a guest cut off at the left edge. The lower half is a featureless blue rectangle. Event documentation with the infrastructure in shot.

frames.subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a rocky seafront under a clear blue sky
frames.reason: Clean private-beach scene with strong turquoise water, but harsh midday light flattens the sand, empty sky takes the top two thirds, and the wooden steps and a boxy fixture clutter the bottom corners. Good support, not hero light.

frames.subject: Terrace bench with polka-dot cushions behind a glass balustrade, gardens and hills beyond
frames.reason: A utility pole and overhead cables cross the sky at right and neighbouring rooftops fill the view; half the frame is a blank white wall and floor with a hard shadow. Cables and clutter are named rejects.

frames.subject: Narrow side passage between a white villa wall and a reed fence
frames.reason: A polished metal post bisects the right of the frame, harsh midday contrast blows the white render and blocks the shadows, and the subject is a service walkway with a strip of lawn — snapshot framing with no story.

frames.subject: Compact bathroom with a shower cabin, wall-hung WC and a round vessel basin on marble
frames.reason: Tidy, styled with a folded towel and a glass vase, warm mirror light, no clutter or utility gear in frame. Wide-angle estate-agent framing and a blank white wall through the middle keep it at gallery support.

frames.subject: Parasailer under a smiley-face canopy behind a speedboat towing an inflatable
frames.reason: Soft, low-resolution activity snapshot with a cartoon parachute and a hazy town waterfront on the horizon; nothing of the estate is in frame and the register is water-sports advertising.
frames.flagReason: Open bay off a built-up town seafront with a commercial watersports boat — a public beach operation, not the estate.

frames.subject: Guests ordering at a thatched wooden bar stocked with spirit bottles
frames.reason: Function clutter throughout: a PA speaker on a stand with cables, a lighting stand, a plastic-skirted cocktail table cropped at right, and a guest in swim shorts at the counter. Catering register, exactly what the standard excludes.

frames.subject: Man in a straw hat crouching beside a crate of fruit on rough grass
frames.reason: Phone snapshot in flat overhead midday sun with a utility pole and wires at top left, a road and parked cars behind the hedge, and burnt patchy grass. Documentary farm register, the same reject as the gardener frame.

frames.subject: Guests dining at round tables under strings of bulbs at blue hour
frames.reason: Genuinely lovely dusk sky and the light strings arc well, but it is event documentation: folding chairs, a white pop-up gazebo, a service pole and wires on the skyline, and a broad expanse of bare concrete in the foreground.

frames.subject: Blue beach towel and a nautical bolster cushion on a sun lounger
frames.reason: Tilted, tightly cropped detail with the lounger cut on every edge and no property context; the cushion slogan and the embossed lettering on the towel carry the frame. Snapshot framing.
frames.flagReason: A tight branded product detail — embossed lettering on the towel and a slogan cushion, with nothing of the estate visible to confirm it was shot on site.

frames.subject: Turquoise private pool beside a white cubic villa with folding glass doors open to the living room
frames.reason: Strong, clean architecture and inviting water, but power lines cross the sky at upper right, hard midday sun flattens the white render, and the timber boundary fence and neighbouring roofs sit across the background. Very usable support; the cables rule out full bleed.

frames.subject: Bathroom with a marble-lined shower cabin, wall-hung WC and a square basin on a timber vanity
frames.reason: Clutter on the counter — a bottle of toiletries and a razor — a protective sticker still on the shower glass, a blown-out window, and exposed plumbing beside the WC. Snapshot documentation rather than styled interior.

frames.subject: Old stone chapel with a bell arch behind a rough drystone wall and pines
frames.reason: Soft, low-resolution frame in flat midday light; the wall crosses the bottom half and the chapel sits small and centred among trees. Handsome subject, weak photograph, and nothing of the estate.
frames.flagReason: A historic chapel or monastery building behind a public boundary wall — heritage site content, not property imagery.

frames.subject: Aerial view of a poolside evening reception with palms and the sea behind
frames.reason: The best overview of the grounds here — pool, palms, thatched bar and open sea in one frame — but the sky is blown flat white, parked cars sit at the right edge, and the terrace is busy with guests, round tables and cocktail furniture. Event documentation quality.

frames.subject: Miniature ouzo bottles in a woven basket
frames.reason: Tight product close-up with shallow depth of field and a blurred background; commercial beverage photography with no property in frame, the same register the standard rejects.
frames.flagReason: A third-party spirits brand's labels carry the whole image and there is no property context — indistinguishable from stock beverage photography.

frames.subject: Loungers with towels and a fruit tray beside a private pool, parasol overhead and a hot tub at the edge
frames.reason: Rich and inviting with clear turquoise water and a styled foreground, but the parasol pole runs dead through the centre, the hot tub is clipped hard at the right edge, and midday sun blows the white paving. Strong support, not a hero.

frames.subject: Palms reflected in a still pool at dusk under strings of bulbs
frames.reason: The mirrored palms and pastel sky give it real calm and near-symmetry, but the sky is washed to near-white, loungers at left are strewn with bags and towels, and black light stands, a beige marquee and a white-skirted table sit along the far edge.

frames.subject: Palm-lined river gorge meeting a crowded sandy beach below arid mountains
frames.reason: Dramatic landscape with good depth, but hazy midday light mutes the hills, the foreground is dry scrub, and the beach is packed with bathers and a tour boat. Usable as area content only.
frames.flagReason: A well-known public palm-gorge beach with crowds and an excursion boat — not the estate's shoreline.

frames.subject: Couple at a linen-dressed table by the sea, a woman in a navy dress raising a cup
frames.reason: Warm low side light and a soft sea backdrop, but it is people-led with both subjects turned away, and a second white-clothed trestle table with a fruit basket crops into the left edge. Real and warm; reads as event coverage.

frames.subject: Scuba diver silhouetted against the sunlit surface in deep blue water
frames.reason: Generic dive-operator imagery — a silhouetted figure and bubble trails with no location cue at all. The same trope as the cyclist rejects: nothing of the property in frame.
frames.flagReason: An anonymous underwater diver shot with no identifiable location; indistinguishable from commercial diving stock photography.

frames.subject: Candles in glass hurricanes stepping down a curved white terrace at dusk
frames.reason: Quiet and atmospheric, with warm flames against cool blue-hour concrete and a pleasing descending diagonal. Held back by a washed-out white sky strip, a bare tree trunk and a pole across the top, and a towel draped on the fence behind.

frames.subject: White cubic villa at blue hour with a glowing interior and a green-lit pool on the lawn
frames.reason: The closest thing to a hero here — deep cobalt sky, controlled warm interior glow, expensive-looking. Falls short of full bleed because an outdoor kitchen counter and sink crop awkwardly into the right foreground and power cables cross the sky above it.

frames.subject: Open-plan living and kitchen area with a dining table, sofa and staircase
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit sits high in the frame at top left — a named reject — alongside a black TV panel, microwave, fridge and small appliances crowding the counter, all in flat, cool interior light.

frames.subject: Carved stone doorway with columns and a pediment in an old masonry facade
frames.reason: Electrical conduit and cables run down the wall on both sides, a meter box is fixed beside the door, green garden hoses lie across the pavement, and the light is flat and harsh. Cables and clutter, in a soft low-resolution frame.
frames.flagReason: A historic town building fronting a paved public street, with a municipal utility box on the facade — a town monument, not the estate.

frames.subject: White sling chairs on a lawn with a cup resting on a footrest
frames.reason: Crooked snapshot: both chairs are cut off, the frame tilts, the near chair is out of focus, and hard midday sun stripes the grass. This is the cropped-lounger-on-grass reject almost exactly.

frames.subject: Villa pool lit magenta at dusk with a wooden deck and a stone retaining wall
frames.reason: The dusk sky and deck lines are good, but a full utility pole with crossarms, insulators and multiple wires stands against the sky right of centre, with a second pole and more wires at left — zoomed in it is unambiguous, and this is the exact item the standard rejects. Two lounger backs are also clipped along the bottom edge, and the magenta LED strip reads garish rather than expensive.

frames.subject: Made-up double bed with folded robes and towels, driftwood and butterfly wall art above the headboard
frames.reason: Tidy, symmetrical and well styled with a breakfast tray on the side shelf, genuinely usable in a room gallery. Flat frontal interior light, plain white wall and visible sockets keep it from hero grade.

frames.subject: Estate name plate mounted on a weathered wooden post against a pale sky
frames.reason: Nearly the whole frame is empty featureless sky with the post jammed against the right edge; it is signage documentation, not a picture. No light, no subject, no place.

frames.subject: Bathroom with a white basin in the foreground, a bathtub and a doorway through to a bedroom
frames.reason: The basin and tap are cropped enormous across the bottom of the frame and a soap dish is half cut off at the corner; a shower hose dangles into the tub and the light is flat. Awkward snapshot framing.

frames.subject: Traditional musicians performing at night in a floodlit arcaded stone courtyard
frames.reason: Purple stage wash, microphone stands, a camera tripod and cables snaking across the paving, with audience heads cut into the bottom corners. Handheld event coverage, poor light discipline.
frames.flagReason: A public concert staged in an arcaded historic monument with an open audience — a town venue, not the estate.

frames.subject: Outdoor dining table with wine and glasses under a pergola, outdoor kitchen behind and a pool at right
frames.reason: Real and usable — good depth from table to pool, clear blue sky, tidy furniture. But slatted fencing dominates the middle band, a printed safety notice hangs on it, and hard midday sun throws heavy shadows across the table.

frames.subject: Glass drink dispensers and ivy garland on a dressed drinks table
frames.reason: Catering gear as the whole subject — three labelled dispensers, ice buckets and beer bottles on a draped trestle against a completely blown-out white sky. No property in frame and the register is event servicing, not villa.

frames.subject: Laid dinner table with glassware beside a pool at dusk
frames.reason: Warm low light, shallow depth of field and elegant place settings make this real and usable event support, but two branded plastic water bottles and a cardboard bread box sit dead centre and the sky behind is blown out — not full-bleed material.

frames.subject: Large pool with guests in white and string lights under a flat pale sky
frames.reason: Utility poles and slack overhead cables across the left third, a flat blank white sky over the whole top half, and scattered event clutter — trolleys, closed umbrellas, staff. Snapshot documentation of a function.

frames.subject: Private pool courtyard with a parasol, loungers and a slatted wood fence
frames.reason: Clean, sharp and real: turquoise water, deep blue sky, tidy deck. Held off hero by hard midday light, a white plastic pool step intruding bottom left and a cluttered right edge of bench and small table.

frames.subject: Pool at blue hour with palm reflections and a figure silhouetted against the sea
frames.reason: Lovely dusk colour and a symmetrical palm reflection, but the file is soft and phone-grade, and the terrace edges carry clutter — coloured bags, stacked chairs, a dressed buffet table and a grey canopy.

frames.subject: Two branded toiletry bottles and a towel beside a white basin
frames.reason: Tight product close-up with no property context at all, and the third-party toiletry brand is the most legible thing in frame. Indistinguishable from generic amenity stock.
frames.flagReason: Carries another company's branding on the bottles and shows no property context; confirm it is in-villa photography before use.

frames.subject: Compact bathroom with a shower cabin, wall-hung WC and a round basin
frames.reason: Flat estate-agent documentation with the toilet centre frame, plumbing fittings and a flush plate on the main wall, and a bright grey blind blowing out the window. Nothing here is editorial.

frames.subject: White villa exterior with a private pool, deck loungers and a parasol
frames.reason: An air-conditioning condenser sits against the wall behind the stairs, overhead cables cross the top left corner, and a white plastic pool step is cropped into the bottom edge. Harsh midday light flattens the facade.

frames.subject: Lit pool at dusk with palms, festoon lights and the sea beyond
frames.reason: Hero grade. A real gradient dusk sky, the pool glowing blue with clean palm reflections, the festoon strand giving a strong diagonal, and an uninterrupted sea horizon. Expensive-looking, simple, and there is clean sky for full-bleed text.

frames.subject: Bed turned down with folded robes and a champagne bucket, shot at a tilt
frames.reason: Crooked framing that throws the whole bed off axis, a plastic-wrapped mattress label as the sharpest element in frame, and a heavy brown throw dominating. Snapshot, not editorial.
frames.flagReason: A third-party mattress maker's logo is prominent and legible in the foreground.

frames.subject: View over a white parapet and bamboo screens to a green field and the sea
frames.reason: Strong blue sky and a clean sea horizon that genuinely sells the seafront setting, but the lower half is taken up by walls and screens, with a concrete shed, a pole and a raw retaining wall in the middle distance.

frames.subject: White bathroom with a jacuzzi tub, shower cabin and an internal window onto a bed
frames.reason: Weak composition — the tub is cropped hard at the bottom left corner, a large blank wall occupies the middle, and the windows blow out to pure white. Documentation framing.

frames.subject: Chef in whites plating a dish in a commercial kitchen
frames.reason: Generic commercial-kitchen stock: stainless shelving, a plastic water bottle on the rack, tungsten-warm cast and a posed plating gesture. Nothing of the property is in frame.
frames.flagReason: Reads as generic commercial food-service stock photography; the setting is an industrial kitchen with no property signature.

frames.subject: Terrace with a parasol and loungers above a stone wall, sea on the horizon
frames.reason: Real and usable — sea visible over the wall, tidy deck, pool at the right. Kept off hero by hard midday shadows, a life ring on the wall, a power line over the boundary and a chair cropped at the bottom edge.

frames.subject: Close-up of a branded white refrigerator door and handle
frames.reason: A manufacturer's logo is the entire subject, everything else is out of focus. No property context; identical to generic appliance product photography.
frames.flagReason: The frame is dominated by another company's brand lettering and shows nothing identifiable as this estate.

frames.subject: Terrace at sunset with a green-lit pool, parasol, loungers and a hot tub
frames.reason: Good dusk colour and controlled pool lighting, and close to hero in feel, but a utility pole and its wires cross the sky left of centre and a parked white van shows on the road at the right — both disqualify full bleed.

frames.subject: Terrace seating and an outdoor kitchen counter under hard midday sun
frames.reason: Cables run across the sky above the fence and a security camera sits on the wall behind the counter. A bunched blue towel with keys and a keyring is the brightest object in the frame, dead centre on the table. Midday sun rakes hard shadows across the paving, and the left third is a sliding glass door reflecting the same furniture back, doubling and confusing the scene.

frames.subject: Young man in a white shirt pouring from a glass jug against the sky
frames.reason: Candid service documentation — subject cropped at the waist by a white wall, a second figure half-cut at the right edge, and overhead cables running through the sky behind him.

frames.subject: Garden path between white buildings leading to the sea
frames.reason: A blue, yellow and green plastic recycling bin sits dead centre on the lawn, with a bare hose and a wire chair cluttering the foreground. The sea is a thin sliver; the bins are what the eye lands on.

frames.subject: Aerial of a seafront complex with a pool, helipad marking and dry fields
frames.reason: Utility aerial: burnt brown scrub over most of the frame, a painted helipad and parked cars in the foreground, and no light or composition to speak of. Survey imagery, not marketing.
frames.flagReason: A single low complex with a helipad and car park; I cannot confirm this is the five-villa estate rather than a neighbouring resort.

frames.subject: Metal fish ornament on a marble shelf above bath taps and a shower head
frames.reason: Odd narrow vertical crop in which chrome plumbing — mixer, hose and handset — occupies the whole lower half. A detail with no scene and no light of its own.

frames.subject: Twin beds pushed together with towel figures and a wall-mounted air conditioner
frames.reason: An air-conditioning unit sits high on the wall directly above the bed, exactly the utility clutter the standard rejects, alongside flat frontal light and towel animals on the coverlet.

frames.subject: Marble bathroom with a jacuzzi tub, petals on the water and a sea view window
frames.reason: The sea framed in the window is a genuine selling point and the marble reads well, but the basin crowds the foreground, a light switch sits on the vanity face, and a wicker basket and loose towels clutter the middle.

frames.subject: Woman and child threading coloured beads at a table indoors
frames.reason: Studio-lit lifestyle stock — pale panelled window, teal armchair and a scatter of craft beads; nothing Greek, coastal or villa-like anywhere in the frame.
frames.flagReason: Generic family-activity stock photography shot in an unrelated interior.

frames.subject: Blue circular logo mark and wordmark on a white ground
frames.reason: Not a photograph at all — a vector brand mark on white. No property, no light, no composition to grade.
frames.flagReason: A corporate wordmark for a different, parent-level brand rather than any imagery of this estate.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate beside a doorway with a pool blurred behind
frames.reason: Shallow-focus signage detail where nearly everything is out of focus, with an orange life-ring blob and a door jamb splitting the left half. A wayfinding record, not a picture.

frames.subject: A tiny dark rectangle, roughly sixteen by twenty-three pixels
frames.reason: Not a usable photograph — the file is a 16x23 pixel near-black block, almost certainly a spacer or tracking image scraped with the library.
frames.flagReason: Content is unreadable at this size; nothing identifiable as the property or as any photograph.

frames.subject: A single-pixel-wide dark vertical strip
frames.reason: Not a photograph — a 1x452 pixel sliver with no image content. Unusable at any size.
frames.flagReason: A one-pixel-wide file with no discernible content; cannot be attributed to the property.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate on a white wall beside a gate, with a key lockbox below
frames.reason: Two thirds of the frame is blown-out white nothing, and a black combination key safe hangs on the stone plinth under the sign. Operational record, not marketing imagery.

frames.subject: Villa entrance with a nameplate on a stone wall and a young olive tree on the side lawn
frames.reason: A black combination keybox is bolted to the stone in the right foreground, prominent and unmissable. Roller shutters and a downpipe run down the wall in the middle, and the left third is a blank white wall blown out by harsh overhead sun with no shape to the light. The composition is split hard down the centre by the gate post into two narrow slots. Utility hardware plus dead wall.

frames.subject: Screenshot of a travel magazine article page with an award badge
frames.reason: Not a photograph of the property — a captured web page of body text, navigation bar and masthead, with a hand-drawn arrow annotation. Unusable as imagery.
frames.flagReason: Carries a third-party publication's masthead and award badge rather than property imagery.

frames.subject: Villa nameplate on a wall with a blurred terrace and key lockbox beneath
frames.reason: Signage detail with everything beyond the sign thrown out of focus, a key safe and loose cable at the bottom left, and unidentifiable coloured clutter on the blurred terrace behind.
